Yeh kitab tamam kitabon se aala, Rasool tamam rasoolon se afzal-o-bala. Jahaan utri woh jagah duniya ki tamam jagahon se behtareen aur umda. Is kitab ka pehla wasf yeh hai ke is ke zariye se tu logon ko andheron se ujaale mein la sakta hai. Tera pehla kaam yeh hai ke gumrahiyon ko hidayat se buraiyon ko bhalaiyon se badal de. Imaanwaron ka hamayati khud Allah hai woh unhein andheron se ujaale mein lata hai aur kafiron ke sathi Allah ke siva aur hain jo unhein noor se hata kar tareekiyon mein phansa dete hain. Allah apne ghulam par apni roshan aur wazih nishaniyan utarta hai ke woh tumhein tareekiyon se hata kar noor ki taraf pohncha de. Asl Hadi Allah hi hai, rasoolon ke haathoon jin ki hidayat isey manzoor hoti hai woh rah pa lete hain aur ghair-mughalib par ghalib zabardast aur har cheez par baadshah ban jaate hain aur har haal mein tareefon wale Allah ki rah ki taraf un ki rahbarri ho jaati hai. Allah ki doosri qiraat Allah bhi hai, pehli qiraat ba-taur sifat ke hai aur doosri ba-taur naye jumle ke, jaise aayat (QUL YA AYYUHAN-NASU INNI RASULULLAHI ILAIKUM JAMI'AN ALLAZI LAHU MULKUS-SAMAWATI WAL-ARDI LA ILAHA ILLA HUWA YUHYI WA YUMITU FA AMINU BILLAHI WA RASULIHIN-NABIYYIL-UMMIYYIL-ALLAZI YU'MINU BILLAHI WA KALIMATIHI WAT-TABI'UHU LAA'ALLAKUM THTADUN) [Surah Al-A'raf: 158] mein. Jo kafir tere mukhalif hain tujhe nahi mante unhein Qiyamat ke din sakht azaab honge. Yeh log duniya ko aakhirat par tarjeeh dete hain, duniya ke liye poori koshish karte hain aur aakhirat ko bhoole baithe hain. Rasoolon ki tabadari se doosron ko bhi rokte hain, rah-e-haq jo seedhi aur saaf hai usey tedhi tarchhi karna chahte hain. Yeh isi jahalat-o-zalalat mein rahenge lekin Allah ki rah na tedhi hui na hogi. Phir aisi halat mein in ki salahiyat ki kya umeed?

Har qoum ki apni zaban mein rasool yeh Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ki intehai darjay ki meherbani hai ke har nabi ko us ki qaumi zaban mein hi bheja taake samajhne samjhane ki asani rahe. Musnad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain har nabi rasool ko Allah Ta'ala ne us ki ummat ki zaban mein hi bheja hai. Haq un par khul to jata hi hai phir hidayat zalaalat Allah ki taraf se hai, us ke chahne ke baghair koi kaam nahi hota. Woh Ghalib hai, uska har kaam hikmat se hai, gumrah wahi hote hain jo us ke mustahiq hon aur hidayat par wahi aate hain jo us ke mustahiq hon. Chunke har nabi sirf apni apni qaum hi ki taraf bheja jata raha is liye usay us ki qaumi zaban mein hi Kitabullah milti thi aur us ki apni zaban bhi wahi hoti thi. An-Hazrat Muhammad bin Abdullah Alaihis Salawatu Wassalam ki risalat aam thi saari duniya ki sab qaumon ki taraf aap Rasulullah thay jaise khud Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke mujhe paanch cheezein khususiyat se di gayi hain jo kisi nabi ko ata nahi huin, mahine bhar ki rah ki doori par sirf rob ke sath meri madad ki gayi hai, mere liye saari zameen masjid aur pakeeza qarar di gayi hai, mujh par maal-e-ghaneemat halal kiye gaye hain jo mujh se pehle kisi par halal nahi thay, mujhe shafaat sonpi gayi hai, har nabi sirf apni qaum hi ki taraf aata tha aur main tamam aam logon ki taraf Rasulullah banaya gaya hoon. Quran yahi farmata hai ke ae nabi elan kardo ke main tum sab ki janib Allah ka rasool hoon ﷺ.

Nu 009 nishaniyan jaise hum ne tujhe apna Rasool bana kar bheja hai aur tujh par apni Kitab nazil farmai hai ke tu logon ko tareekiyon se nikal kar noor ki taraf le aaye. Isi tarah hum ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko Bani Israel ki taraf bheja tha bahut si nishaniyan bhi di thin jin ka bayan ayat (Walaqad ataina Musa tis'a ayatin bayyinatin fas'al Bani Isra'ila iz ja'ahum fa-qala lahu Fir'awnu inni la-azunnuka ya Musa mashura, 17. (Al-Isra: 101) mein hai. Unhein bhi yahi hukum tha ke logon ko nekiyon ki dawat de unhein andheron se nikal kar roshni mein aur jahalat-o-zalalat se hata kar ilm-o-hidayat ki taraf le aa. Unhein Allah ke ahsanat yaad dila. Ke Allah ne unhein Fir'awn jaise zalim-o-jabir badshah ki ghulami se azad kiya un ke liye darya ko khara kar diya un par abr ka saya kar diya un par mann-o-salwa utara aur bhi bahut si na'amatein ata farmai. Masnad ki marfu' hadith mein Ayyam-ullah ki tafsir Allah ki na'amaton se marwi hai. Lekin Ibn Jarir Rahimahullah mein yeh riwayat Ubayy bin Ka'ab Razi Allahu Anhu hi se mawqufan bhi aayi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Hum ne apne bando Bani Israel ke sath jo ahsan kiye Fir'awn se nijat dilwana, us ke zaleel azabon se chhurwana, us mein har sabir-o-shakir ke liye ibrat hai. Jo museebat mein sabr kare aur rahat mein shukr kare. Sahih hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Momin ka tamam kaam ajeeb hai use museebat ponche toh sabr karta hai wahi us ke haq mein behtar hota hai aur agar use rahat-o-aram mile shkar karta hai us ka anjam bhi us ke liye behtar hota hai.)

Aulad ka qatil

Frman-e-Ilahi ke mutabiq Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam apni kaum ko Allah ki neematein yaad dila rahe hain. Masalan kaum-e-Firaun se unhein nijat dilwana jo unhein bewuqat kar ke un par tarah tarah ke mazalim dha rahe the yahan tak ke tamam narina aulad qatal kar dalte the sirf larkiyon ko zinda chhodte the. Yeh nemat itni badi hai ke tum is ki shukr guzari ki taqat nahi rakhte. Yeh matlab bhi is jumle ka ho sakta hai ke Firauni ezaaz darasal tumhari ek bahut badi aazmaish thi aur yeh bhi ihtimal hai ke donon maani murad hon, Wallahu Aalam. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa balawnhum bilhasanati was-sayyiati la'allahum yarji'un) (Al-A'raf: 168) yani hum ne unhein bhalai burai se aazma liya ke woh laut aayein. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe aagah kar diya. Aur yeh maani bhi mumkin hain ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne qasam khai apni izzat-o-jalalat aur kibriyai ki. Jaise ayat (Wa iz ta'azzana rabbuka layab'athanna 'alaihim ila yaumil-qiyamati man yasumuhum su'al-azaab) (Al-A'raf: 167) mein. Pas Allah ka hatmi wada hua aur is ka elan bhi ke shukr guzaron ki neematein aur badh jayegi aur nashakron ki neematein ke munkaron aur un ke chhupane walon ki neematein aur chhinh jayengi aur unhein sakht saza hogi. Hadis mein hai banda wajah gunah ke Allah ki rozi se mahroom ho jata hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas se ek sail guzra, Aap ne use ek khajoor di. Woh bada bigda aur khajoor na li. Phir dusra sail guzra Aap ne use bhi wahi khajoor di us ne use bakhushi le liya aur kehne laga ke Allah ke Rasool ka atiya hai. Aap ne use bees dirham dene ka hukum farmaya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne laundi se farmaya ise le jao aur Hazrat Umme Salmah R.A ke paas chalis dirham hain woh ise dilwa do. 

Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne Bani Israel se فرمایا ke tum sab aur roye zameen ki tamam makhluq bhi nashukri karne lage to Allah ka kya bigade ga? Woh bandon se aur un ki shukr guzari se beniyaz aur beparwah hai. Tareefon ka malik aur qabil wahi hai. Chunancha farman hai ayat (In takfuru fa-innallaha ghaniyyun 'ankum wa la yarda li-'ibadihil-kufr, wa in tashkuru yardahu lakum, wa la taziru waziratun wizra ukhra, thumma ila rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bima kuntum ta'malun, innahu 'alimum bi-zatis-sudur) (Az-Zumar: 7) Tum agar kufr karo to Allah tum se ghani hai aur ayat mein hai ayat (Fa kafaru wa tawallaw wastaghnallah, wallahu ghaniyyun hamid) (At-Taghabun: 6) Unhon ne kufr kiya munh mod liya to Allah ne un se mutlaqan beniyazi barti.

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Qudsi hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Ae mere bando! Agar tumhare awwal-o-akhir insan-o-jinn sab mil kar behtareen taqway wale dil ke shakhs jaise ban jayein, to us se mera mulk zara sa bhi barh na jaye ga. Aur agar tumhare sab agle pachle insan-o-jinn badtareen dil ke ban jayein, to us wajah se mere mulk mein se ek zarra bhi na ghate ga. Ae mere bando! Agar tumhare agle pachle insan-o-jinn sab ek maidan mein khare ho jayein aur mujh se maanghein aur main har ek ka sawal poora kar dun, to bhi mere paas ke khazanon mein itni hi kami aayegi jitni kami samandar mein sui dalne se ho." Pas hamara Rab pak hai, buland hai, ghani hai aur Hameed hai.

Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ka baqi wa'z bayaan ho raha hai ke aap ne apni qaum ko Allah ki woh neamatein yaad dilate huwe farmaya ke dekho tum se pehle ke logon par Rasoolon ke jhutlane ki wajah se kaise sakht azaab aaye? Aur kis tarah woh ghaarat kiye gaye? Yeh qool to hai Imam Ibn Jarir Rahimahullah ka lekin zara ghaur talab hai. Zahir hai to aisa maloom hota hai ke woh wa'z to khatam ho chuka ab yeh naya bayaan Quran hai. Kaha gaya hai ke Adiyon aur Samudiyon ke waqiat Torat Sharif mein thay aur yeh dono waqiat bhi Torat mein thay Wallahu A'lam. Fi al-jumla un logon ke aur un jaise aur bhi bahut se logon ke waqiat Quran Karim mein hamare samne bayaan ho chuke hain ke un ke paas Allah ke Paighambar Allah ki aayetein aur Allah ke diye huwe mojize lekar pahunche un ki ginti ka ilm sirf Allah hi ko hai. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain nasab ke bayaan karne wale ghalat go hain bahut se logon ke waqiat Quran Karim mein hamare samne bayaan ho chuke hain ke un ke paas Allah ke Paighambar Allah ki aayetein aur Allah ke diye huwe mojize lekar pahunche un ki ginti ka ilm sirf Allah hi ko hai. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain nasab ke bayaan karne wale ghalat go hain bahut si umatein aisi bhi guzri hain jin ka ilm Allah ke siwa kisi ko nahi. Urwah bin Zubair ka bayaan hai ke Ma'ad bin Adnan ke baad ka nasab nama sahih taur par koi nahi janta. Woh apne haath un ke munh tak lota liye gaye ke ek maana to yeh hain ke Rasoolon ke munh band karne lage. Ek maana yeh bhi hain ke woh apne haath apne munh par rakhne lage ke mahz jhoot hai jo Rasool kehte hain. Ek maana yeh bhi hain ke jawab se lachar ho kar ungliyan munh par rakh lein. Kuffar aur Anbiya mein mukalmat rasoolon ki aur un ki kaum ke kafiron ki baat cheet bayan ho rahi hai. Kaum ne Allah ki ibadat mein shak-o-shubha ka izhar kiya, is par rasoolon ne kaha Allah ke bare mein shak? Yani us ke wujood mein shak kaisa? Fitrat us ki shahid-e-adl hai, insan ki bunyad mein us ka iqrar maujood hai. Aql-e-saleem us ke manne par majboor hai. Achha agar daleel ke baghair itminan nahi toh dekh lo ke yeh asman-o-zameen kaise paida ho gaye? Maujood ke liye maujid ka hona zaroori hai. Inhe baghair namuna paida karne wala wohi Wahid-o-La Sharik Lahu hai. Is alam ki takhleeq ka mutee-o-makhlooq hona bilkul zahir hai, is se kya itni moti baat bhi samajh nahi aati? Ke us ka sani uska khaliq hai aur wohi Allah Ta'ala hai jo har cheez ka khaliq, malik aur mabood-e-barhaq hai. Ya kya tumhe us ki uluhiyat aur us ki wahdaniyat mein shak hai? Jab tamam maujoodaat ka khaliq aur maujood wohi hai toh phir ibadat mein tanha wohi kyun na ho? Chunke aksar ummaten khaliq ke wujood ke qayil theen, phir auron ki ibadat unhe wasita aur waseela jaan kar Allah se nazdeek karne wale aur nafa dene wale samajh kar karti theen, is liye rasool unhe un ki ibadaton se yeh samjha kar rokte hain. 

Allah Ta'ala tumhe apni taraf bula raha hai ke akhirat mein tumhare gunah maaf farma de aur jo waqt muqarrar hai tak tumhe achhai se pahuncha de, har ek fazilat wale ko woh us ki fazilat inayat farmayega. Ab ummaton ne pehle maqam ko tasleem karne ke baad jawab diya ke tumhari risalat hum kaise maan lein? "Tum mein insaniyat toh hum jaisi hi hai, achha agar sachhe ho toh zabardast mojiza pesh karo jo insani taqat se bahar ho?" Is ke jawab mein paighambaran-e-Rab ne farmaya ke yeh toh bilkul muslim hai ke hum tum jaise hi insan hain, lekin risalat-o-nabuwat Allah ka atiya hai, woh jise chahe de. Insaniyat risalat ke manafi nahi. Aur jo cheez tum hamare hathon se dekhna chahte ho, us ki nisbat bhi sun lo ke woh hamare bas ki baat nahi, haan hum Allah se talab karenge agar hamari dua maqbool hui toh beshak hum dikha denge. Muminon ko toh har kaam mein Allah hi par tawakkul hai, aur khususiyaat ke sath hamein is par zyada tawakkul aur bharosa hai, is liye bhi ke us ne tamam rahon mein se behtareen rah dikhai. Tum jitna chaho dukh do lekin Insha'Allah daman-e-tawakkul hamare hath se chhootne ka nahi. Mutawakkilin ke giroh ke liye Allah ka tawakkul kafi wafi hai.

Aal-e-Lut ke kafir jab tang hue, koi hujjat baaki na rahi toh nabiyon ko dhamkaane lage aur dais nikaalne se daraane lage. Qaum-e-Shu'aib ne bhi apne nabi aur mominon se yahi kaha tha ki hum tumhein apni basti se nikaal denge. Lootiyon ne bhi yahi kaha tha ki Aal-e-Lut ko apne shehar se nikaal do. Woh agarche makar karte thay lekin Allah bhi un ke dao mein tha. Apne nabi ko salamati ke sath Makkah se le gaya Madine walon ko aap ka ansar-o-madadgaar bana diya woh aap ke lashkar mein shamil ho kar aap ke jhande tale kafiron se lade aur badar-tarij Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko tarqqiyan din yahan tak ki bil-akhir aap ne Makkah bhi fath kar liya ab toh dushmanan-e-din ke mansobe khaak mein mil gaye un ki umidon par os pad gayi un ki aarzuwein pamal ho gayin. Allah ka din logon ke dilon mein mazboot ho gaya, jama'aton ki jama'atein din mein dakhil hone lagin, tamam ro-e-zameen ke adyan par din-e-Islam cha gaya, kalma-e-haq buland-o-bala ho gaya aur thode se zamane mein mashriq se maghrib tak isha'at-e-Islam ho gayi fa Alhamdulillah. Yahan farman hai ki udhar kuffar ne nabiyon ko dhamkaya udhar Allah ne un se sacha wada farmaya ki yahi halak honge aur zameen ke malik tum banoge. Jise farman hai ki hamara kalma hamare rasoolon ke bare mein sabaqat kar chuka hai ki wahi kamyaab honge aur hamara lashkar hi ghalib rahega aur aayat mein hai aayat (Katabal-lahu la-aglibanna ana wa rusuli innal-laha qawiyyun 'aziz) (Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah likh chuka hai ki main aur mere paighambar hi ghalib aayenge, Allah quwwat wala aur izzat wala hai. Aur aayat mein irshad hai ki zikr ke baad Zaboor mein bhi yahi tehreer hai. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi apni qaum se yahi farmaya tha ki tum Allah se madad talab karo, sabr-o-bardasht karo, zameen Allah hi ki hai. Apne bandon mein se jise chahe waris banaye anjam-e-kar parh-gaaron ka hi hai. Aur jagah irshad hai. Aayat (Wa aurasnal-qaumal-lazina kanu yustad'afuna mashariqal-ardi wa magharibahal-lati barakna fiha) (Al-A'raf: 137) Zaif aur kamzor logon ko hum ne zameen ki mashriq-o-maghrib ka waris bana diya jahan hamari barkatein thin Bani Israel ke sabr ki wajah se hamara un se jo behtareen wada tha woh pura ho gaya un ke dushman Firaun aur Firauniyon aur un ki tamam tiyariyan sab yak-musht khaak mein mil gayin. Nabiyon se farma diya gaya ki yeh zameen tumhare qabze mein aayegi yeh wade un ke liye hain jo qayamat ke din mere samne khade hone se darte rahen aur mere darawe aur azab se khauf khate rahen. Jaise farman-e-bari hai aayat (Fa amma man tagha) (An-Nazi'at: 37), yaani jis ne sarkashi aur duniyawi zindagi ko tarjeeh di us ka thikana jahannam hai. Aur aayat mein hai apne Rab ke samne khade hone ka khauf jis ne kiya use dohri jannatein hain.

Rasulon ne apne Rab se madad-o-fath aur faisla talab kiya ya yeh ke unki kaum ne ise talab kiya jaise Quraysh-e-Makkah ne kaha tha ke Ilahi agar yeh haq hai toh hum par aasmaan se patthar barsa ya aur koi dardnaak azaab humein kar. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke udhar se kuffar ka mutalba hua udhar se Rasulon ne bhi Allah se dua ki jaise Badr waale din hua tha ke ek taraf Rasulullah ﷺ dua maang rahe the dusri jaanib sardaraan-e-kufr bhi keh rahe the ke Ilahi aaj sachche ko ghalib kar yahi hua bhi. Mushrikeen se kalaam-e-Allah mein aur jagah farmaya gaya hai ke tum fath talab kiya karte the lo ab woh aa gayi ab bhi agar baaz aa jao toh tumhare haq mein behtar hai al-kh. Nuqsan yaafta woh hain jo mutakabbir hon apne taiin kuch ginte hon haq se inaad rakhte hon qiyamat ke roz farmaan hoga ke har ek kafir sarkash aur bhalayi se rokne waale ko Jahannam mein daakhil karo jo Allah ke saath dusron ki puja karta tha use saqt azaab mein le jao. Hadith shareef mein hai ke qiyamat ke din Jahannam ko laya jayega woh tamaam makhlooq ko nida kar ke kahegi ke main har ek sarkash ziddi ke liye muqarrar ki gayi hoon al-kh. Us waqt in bad-logon ka kya hi bura haal hoga jab ke anbiya tak Allah ke saamne gidgida rahe honge. Wara' yahan par maane "imam" saamne ke hain jaise aayat (wa kaana wara'ahum malik) mein hai Ibn Abbas ki qiraat hi wa kaana imamahum malik hai gharz saamne se Jahannam uski taak mein hogi jis mein jaakar phir nikalna namumkin hoga qiyamat ke din tak toh subh shaam woh pesh hoti rahi ab wahi thikana ban gaya phir wahan uske liye paani ke badle aag jaisa peep hai aur had se zyada thanda aur badbudaar woh paani hai jo jahannumiyon ke zakhmon se rasta hai. Jaise farmaan aayat (Haza falyazuquhu hamimun wa ghassaq) (Sad: 57). Pas ek garmi mein had se guzra hua ek sardi mein had se guzra hua. Sadeed kehte hain peep aur khoon ko jo dozakhiyon ke gosht se aur unki khalon se baha hua hoga. Isi ko tinat-ul-khabal bhi kaha gaya hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab uske paas laya jayega toh use saqt takleef hogi munh ke paas pahunchte hi saare chehre ki khaal jhulas kar us mein gir padegi. Ek ghont lete hi pet ki aanten paakhane ke raaste baahar nikal padengi. Allah ka farmaan hai ke woh kholta hua garam paani pilaye jayenge jo chehra jhulaas de al-kh. Jabran ghont ghont kar ke utarega, farishte lohe ke gurz maar maar kar pilayenge, bad-mazgi, badbu, hararat, garmi ki tezi ya sardi ki tezi ki wajah se gale se utarna muhaal hoga. Badan mein, azaa mein, jodh jodh mein woh dard aur takleef hogi ke maut ka maza aaye lekin maut aane ki nahi. Rag rag par azaab hai lekin jaan nahi nikalti. Ek ek rawan naqaabil-e-bardasht museebat mein jakda hua hai lekin rooh badan se juda nahi ho sakti. Aage peeche daayein baayein se maut aa rahi hai lekin aati nahi. Tarah tarah ke azaab dozakh ki aag ghere hue hai magar maut balaaye se bhi nahi aati. Na maut aaye na azaab jaaye.

Har saza aisi hai ke maut ke liye kafi se zyada hai lekin wahan to maut ko maut aa gayi hai taake saza dawam wali hoti rahe. In tamam baaton ke saath phir sakht tar museebat naak alam afza azab aur hain. Jaise Zaqqum ke darakht ke bare mein farmaya ke woh jahannam ki jad se nikalta hai jis ke shagofe shaitanon ke saron jaise hain woh isay khayenge aur pait bhar ke khayenge phir kholta hua tez garam pani pait mein ja kar is se milega phir un ka lotna jahannam ki jaanib hai. Al-Gharz kabhi Zaqqum khane ka kabhi aag mein jalne ka kabhi sadeed peene ka azab unhein hota rahega. Allah ki panah. Farman-e-Rabb-e-Aalishan hai ayat (Hazih-i jahannamul-lati yukazzibu bihal-mujridoon) (Surah (Ar-Rahman: 43) Yahi woh jahannam hai jise kafir jhutlate rahe. Aaj jahannam ke aur ubalte hue tez garam pani ke darmiyan woh chakkar khate phirenge. Aur ayat mein hai ke Zaqqum ka darakht gunahgaron ki ghiza hai jo pighalte hue tanbe jaisa hoga, pait mein ja kar ubale ga aur aise josh marega jaise garam pani khol raha ho. Isay pakdo aur isay beech jahannam mein daal do phir is ke sar par garam pani ke tareede ka azab bahao maza chakkh tu apne khayal mein bada azeez tha aur ikram wala tha yahi jis se tum hamesha shak shuba karte rahe. Surah Waqi'ah mein farmaya ke woh log jin ke bayen haath mein nama-e-amal diye jayenge yeh bayen haath wale kaise bad log hain garam hawa aur garam pani mein pade hue honge aur dhuein ke saye mein jo na thanda na ba-izzat dusri aayat mein hai sarkashon ke liye jahannam ka bura thikana hai jis mein dakhil honge aur woh rehayish ki badtareen jagah hai is museebat ke saath tez garam pani aur peep lahu aur usi ke ham-shakal aur bhi qisam qisam ke azab honge jo dozakhiyon ko bhugatne padenge jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi janta yeh un ke aamal ka badla hoga na ke Allah ka zulm.)

Jise farman hai ki hamara kalma hamare rasoolon ke bare mein sabaqat kar chuka hai ki wahi kamyaab honge aur hamara lashkar hi ghalib rahega aur aayat mein hai aayat (Katabal-lahu la-aglibanna ana wa rusuli innal-laha qawiyyun 'aziz) (Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah likh chuka hai ki main aur mere paighambar hi ghalib aayenge, Allah quwwat wala aur izzat wala hai. Aur aayat mein irshad hai ki zikr ke baad Zaboor mein bhi yahi tehreer hai. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi apni qaum se yahi farmaya tha ki tum Allah se madad talab karo, sabr-o-bardasht karo, zameen Allah hi ki hai. Apne bandon mein se jise chahe waris banaye anjam-e-kar parh-gaaron ka hi hai. Aur jagah irshad hai. Aayat (Wa aurasnal-qaumal-lazina kanu yustad'afuna mashariqal-ardi wa magharibahal-lati barakna fiha) (Al-A'raf: 137) Zaif aur kamzor logon ko hum ne zameen ki mashriq-o-maghrib ka waris bana diya jahan hamari barkatein thin Bani Israel ke sabr ki wajah se hamara un se jo behtareen wada tha woh pura ho gaya un ke dushman Firaun aur Firauniyon aur un ki tamam tiyariyan sab yak-musht khaak mein mil gayin. Nabiyon se farma diya gaya ki yeh zameen tumhare qabze mein aayegi yeh wade un ke liye hain jo qayamat ke din mere samne khade hone se darte rahen aur mere darawe aur azab se khauf khate rahen. Jaise farman-e-bari hai aayat (Fa amma man tagha) (An-Nazi'at: 37), yaani jis ne sarkashi aur duniyawi zindagi ko tarjeeh di us ka thikana jahannam hai. Aur aayat mein hai apne Rab ke samne khade hone ka khauf jis ne kiya use dohri jannatein hain.

Rasulon ne apne Rab se madad-o-fath aur faisla talab kiya ya yeh ke unki kaum ne ise talab kiya jaise Quraysh-e-Makkah ne kaha tha ke Ilahi agar yeh haq hai toh hum par aasmaan se patthar barsa ya aur koi dardnaak azaab humein kar. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke udhar se kuffar ka mutalba hua udhar se Rasulon ne bhi Allah se dua ki jaise Badr waale din hua tha ke ek taraf Rasulullah ﷺ dua maang rahe the dusri jaanib sardaraan-e-kufr bhi keh rahe the ke Ilahi aaj sachche ko ghalib kar yahi hua bhi. Mushrikeen se kalaam-e-Allah mein aur jagah farmaya gaya hai ke tum fath talab kiya karte the lo ab woh aa gayi ab bhi agar baaz aa jao toh tumhare haq mein behtar hai al-kh. Nuqsan yaafta woh hain jo mutakabbir hon apne taiin kuch ginte hon haq se inaad rakhte hon qiyamat ke roz farmaan hoga ke har ek kafir sarkash aur bhalayi se rokne waale ko Jahannam mein daakhil karo jo Allah ke saath dusron ki puja karta tha use saqt azaab mein le jao. Hadith shareef mein hai ke qiyamat ke din Jahannam ko laya jayega woh tamaam makhlooq ko nida kar ke kahegi ke main har ek sarkash ziddi ke liye muqarrar ki gayi hoon al-kh. Us waqt in bad-logon ka kya hi bura haal hoga jab ke anbiya tak Allah ke saamne gidgida rahe honge. Wara' yahan par maane "imam" saamne ke hain jaise aayat (wa kaana wara'ahum malik) mein hai Ibn Abbas ki qiraat hi wa kaana imamahum malik hai gharz saamne se Jahannam uski taak mein hogi jis mein jaakar phir nikalna namumkin hoga qiyamat ke din tak toh subh shaam woh pesh hoti rahi ab wahi thikana ban gaya phir wahan uske liye paani ke badle aag jaisa peep hai aur had se zyada thanda aur badbudaar woh paani hai jo jahannumiyon ke zakhmon se rasta hai. Jaise farmaan aayat (Haza falyazuquhu hamimun wa ghassaq) (Sad: 57). Pas ek garmi mein had se guzra hua ek sardi mein had se guzra hua. Sadeed kehte hain peep aur khoon ko jo dozakhiyon ke gosht se aur unki khalon se baha hua hoga. Isi ko tinat-ul-khabal bhi kaha gaya hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab uske paas laya jayega toh use saqt takleef hogi munh ke paas pahunchte hi saare chehre ki khaal jhulas kar us mein gir padegi. Ek ghont lete hi pet ki aanten paakhane ke raaste baahar nikal padengi. Allah ka farmaan hai ke woh kholta hua garam paani pilaye jayenge jo chehra jhulaas de al-kh. Jabran ghont ghont kar ke utarega, farishte lohe ke gurz maar maar kar pilayenge, bad-mazgi, badbu, hararat, garmi ki tezi ya sardi ki tezi ki wajah se gale se utarna muhaal hoga. Badan mein, azaa mein, jodh jodh mein woh dard aur takleef hogi ke maut ka maza aaye lekin maut aane ki nahi. Rag rag par azaab hai lekin jaan nahi nikalti. Ek ek rawan naqaabil-e-bardasht museebat mein jakda hua hai lekin rooh badan se juda nahi ho sakti. Aage peeche daayein baayein se maut aa rahi hai lekin aati nahi. Tarah tarah ke azaab dozakh ki aag ghere hue hai magar maut balaaye se bhi nahi aati. Na maut aaye na azaab jaaye.

Har saza aisi hai ke maut ke liye kafi se zyada hai lekin wahan to maut ko maut aa gayi hai taake saza dawam wali hoti rahe. In tamam baaton ke saath phir sakht tar museebat naak alam afza azab aur hain. Jaise Zaqqum ke darakht ke bare mein farmaya ke woh jahannam ki jad se nikalta hai jis ke shagofe shaitanon ke saron jaise hain woh isay khayenge aur pait bhar ke khayenge phir kholta hua tez garam pani pait mein ja kar is se milega phir un ka lotna jahannam ki jaanib hai. Al-Gharz kabhi Zaqqum khane ka kabhi aag mein jalne ka kabhi sadeed peene ka azab unhein hota rahega. Allah ki panah. Farman-e-Rabb-e-Aalishan hai ayat (Hazih-i jahannamul-lati yukazzibu bihal-mujridoon) (Surah (Ar-Rahman: 43) Yahi woh jahannam hai jise kafir jhutlate rahe. Aaj jahannam ke aur ubalte hue tez garam pani ke darmiyan woh chakkar khate phirenge. Aur ayat mein hai ke Zaqqum ka darakht gunahgaron ki ghiza hai jo pighalte hue tanbe jaisa hoga, pait mein ja kar ubale ga aur aise josh marega jaise garam pani khol raha ho. Isay pakdo aur isay beech jahannam mein daal do phir is ke sar par garam pani ke tareede ka azab bahao maza chakkh tu apne khayal mein bada azeez tha aur ikram wala tha yahi jis se tum hamesha shak shuba karte rahe. Surah Waqi'ah mein farmaya ke woh log jin ke bayen haath mein nama-e-amal diye jayenge yeh bayen haath wale kaise bad log hain garam hawa aur garam pani mein pade hue honge aur dhuein ke saye mein jo na thanda na ba-izzat dusri aayat mein hai sarkashon ke liye jahannam ka bura thikana hai jis mein dakhil honge aur woh rehayish ki badtareen jagah hai is museebat ke saath tez garam pani aur peep lahu aur usi ke ham-shakal aur bhi qisam qisam ke azab honge jo dozakhiyon ko bhugatne padenge jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi janta yeh un ke aamal ka badla hoga na ke Allah ka zulm.)

Be-sud aamal kafir jo Allah ke sath doosron ki ibadaton ke khugar thay, paighambaron ki nahi mantay thay, jin ke aamal aisay thay jaise bunyad ke baghair imarat ho, jin ka natija yeh huwa ke sakht zaroorat ke waqt khali hath kharay reh gaye. Pas farman hai ke in kafiryon ki yani in ke aamal ki misal. Qayamat ke din jab ke yeh pooray mohtaj honge samajh rahe honge ke abhi abhi hamari bhalaiyon ka badla hamein milay ga lekin kuch na payein ge, mayoos reh jayein ge, hasrat se munh takne lagenge jaise taiz aandhi walay din hawa rakh ko ura kar zarra zarra idhar udhar bikher de, isi tarah in ke aamal mahz akart ho gaye jaise is bikhri hui aur uri hui rakh ka jama karna muhal, aisay hi in ke be-sud aamal ka badla muhal. Woh to wahan honge hi nahi, in ke anay se pehlay hi haba manshoora ho gaye. Aayat: (Mathalu ma yunfiqoona fi hazihil-hayatid-dunya kamathali rihin fiha sirrun asabat hartha qawmin zalamoo anfusahum fa ahlakathu - 3. (Al-Imran: 117). Yeh kuffar jo kuch is hayat-e-dunya mein kharch karte hain, us ki misal us aag ke golay jaisi hai jo zalimon ki kheti jhulsa de. Allah zalim nahi lekin woh apne upar khud zulm karte hain. Aur aayat mein hai ke iman walo apne sadqe khairaat ehsan rakh kar aur eza de kar barbad na karo jaise woh jo riya kari ke liye kharch karta ho aur Allah par aur qayamat par iman na rakhta ho, us ki misal us chattana ki tarah hai jis par mitti thi lekin barish ke pani ne usay dho diya ab woh bilkul saf ho gaya, yeh log apni kamai mein se kisi cheez par qadir nahi, Allah Ta'ala kafiron ki rehbari nahi farmata. Is aayat mein irshad huwa ke yeh door ki gumraahi hai, in ki koshish un ke kaam be-paye aur be-sabaat hain, sakht hajat-mandi ke waqt sawab gum payein ge, yahi intehai bad-qismati hai.)

Hayat-e-Sania Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Qiyamat ke din ki dobara paidaish par main qadir hoon. Jab main ne aasman zameen ki paidaish kardi to insan ki paidaish mujh par kya mushkil hai. Aasman ki oonchai kashadgi barai phir us mein thahere hue aur chalte phirte sitare. Aur yeh zameen paharon aur jangalon darakhton aur haivanon wali sab Allah hi ki banayi hui hai jo un ki paidaish se aajiz na aaya woh kya murdon ke dobara zinda karne par qadir nahi? Beshak qadir hai. Surah Yaseen mein farmaya ke kya insan ne nahi dekha ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kiya phir woh jhagda-lu ban baitha. Hamare samne misalein bayan karne laga apni paidaish bhool gaya aur kehne laga in boseeda hadiyon ko kaun zinda karega? Keh de ke wohi Allah jis ne unhe awwal bar paida kiya woh har cheez ki paidaish ko bakhubi janta hai usi ne sabz darakht se tumhare liye aag banayi hai ke tum use jalate ho. Kya aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq un jaison ki paidaish par qadir nahi? Beshak hai, wohi bara khaliq aur bahut bara aalim hai us ke irade ke baad us ka sirf itna hukm bas hai ke hoja usi waqt woh hojata hai woh Allah pak hai jis ke haath mein har cheez ki badshahat hai aur jis ki taraf tumhara sab ka lotna hai. Us ke qabze mein hai ke agar chahe to tum sab ko fana kar de aur nayi makhlooq tumhare qaim-maqam yahan abad kar de is par yeh kaam bhi bhari nahi tum us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ka khilaf karoge to yahi hoga jaise farmaya agar tum munh mor loge to woh tumhare badle aur qaum layega jo tumhari tarah ki na hogi. Aur ayat mein hai Ae iman walo tum mein se jo shakhs apne deen se phirjaye to Allah Ta'ala ek aisi qaum ko layega jo us ki pasandeeda hogi aur us se mohabbat rakhne wali hogi. Aur jagah hai agar woh chahe tumhe barbad kar de aur dusre laye Allah us par qadir hai.

Chatil maidan aur makhlooq:

Saaf chatil maidan mein saari makhlooq naik-o-bad Allah ke samne maujood hogi. Us waqt jo log matahat thay un se kahenge jo sardar aur bare thay aur jo unhein Allah ki ibadat aur Rasool ki itaat se rokte thay, ke hum tumhare tabe-farman thay jo hukum tum dete thay hum baja late thay, jo tum farmate thay hum mante thay. Pas jaise ke tum hum se wade karte thay aur humein tamannayein dilate thay, kya aaj Allah ke azabon ko hum se hataoge? 

Us waqt yeh paishwa aur sardar kahenge ke hum to khud rah-e-rast par na thay, tumhari rahbarisi kaise karte? Hum par Allah ka kalma sabaqat kar gaya, azab ke mustahiq hum sab ho gaye. Ab na haye-o-waye aur na be-qarari nafa de aur na sabr-o-bardasht. Azab ke bachao ki tamam soortein na-paeed hain. 

Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid farmate hain ke dozakhi log kahenge ke dekho yeh musalman Allah ke samne rote-dhote thay is wajah se woh jannat mein phonche, aao hum bhi Allah ke samne royein girgirayein. Khoob royein peetenge, cheekhein chalayenge lekin be-sood rahega. To kahenge jannatiyon ke jannat mein jane ki ek wajah sabr karna thi, aao hum bhi khamosh aur sabr ikhtiyar karein, ab aisa sabr karenge ke aisa sabr kabhi dekha nahi gaya, lekin yeh bhi la-hasil rahega. Us waqt kahenge haye sabr bhi be-sood aur be-qarari bhi be-nafa. 

Zahir to yeh hai ke paishwaon aur tabadaron ki yeh baat-cheet jahannam mein jane ke baad hogi, jaise ayat (Wa iz yatahajjoona fin-nar) al-akh, jab ke woh jahannam mein jhagarenge, us waqt zaeef log takabbur walon se kahenge ke hum tumhare matahat thay to kya aag ke kisi hisse se tum hamein nijat dila sakoge? Woh mutakabbir log kahenge hum to sab jahannam mein maujood hain, Allah ke faisle bando mein ho chuke hain. 

Aur ayat mein hai: (Qaludkhuloo fi umamin qad khalat min qablikum minal-jinni wal-insi fin-nar) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 38). Farmayega ke jao un logon mein shamil ho jao jo insan jinat tum se pehle jahannam mein pahunch chuke hain, jo giroh jayega woh doosre ko laanat karta jayega. Jab sab ke sab jama ho jayenge to pichle pehlon ki nisbat janab-e-bari mein arz karenge ke parwardigar in logon ne hamein to behka diya, inhein dohra azab kar. Jawab milega ke har ek ko dohra hai lekin tum nahi jante. Aur agle pichlon se kahenge ke tumhein hum par fazilat nahi thi, apne kiye hue kaam ke badle ka azab chakho. 

Aur ayat mein hai ke woh kahenge ayat: (Wa qaloo rabbana inna ata'na sadatana wa kubarana fa-adalloonas-sabeela) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 67) al-akh, aye hamare parwardigar! Hum ne apne paishwaon aur baron ki itaat ki jinhon ne hamein raste se bhatka diya, aye hamare palanhar! Tu inhein dohra azab kar aur bari laanat kar. 

Yeh log mahshar mein bhi jhagarenge, farman hai: (Wa lau tara izaz-zalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim) (Surah (Al-Fatir: 31).

Saba :31) Kash ke tu dekhta jab ke zalim log Allah ke samne khare hue ek dusre se lar jhagar rahe honge, tabedar log apne baron se kehte honge ke kya hidayat aa jane ke baad hum ne tumhein is se rok diya? Nahin, balki tum to aap gunahgar badkar the. Yeh kamzor log phir un zor awron se kahenge ke tumhare raat din ke dao ghaat aur humein yeh hukum dena ke hum Allah se kufr karein, uske sharik tehraein! Ab sab log poshida taur par apni apni jagah nadam ho jayenge jab ke azabon ko samne dekh lenge. Hum kafiron ki gardanon mein tauq dal denge, unhein unke aamal ka badla zaroor milega.))

Totā chashm dushman shaitan, Allah Ta'ala jab bandon ki qaza se farigh hoga, momin jannat mein kafir dozakh mein pahunch jayenge, us waqt Iblis maloon jahannam mein khada ho kar un se kahega ke Allah ke waade sachche aur barhaq thay, rasoolon ki tabadari mein hi najat aur salamati thi, mere waade to dhoke thay main to tumhein ghalat rah par dalne ke liye sabz bagh dikhaya karta tha. Meri baatein be-dalil thein, mera kalam be-hujjat tha. Mera koi zor ya ghalba tum par na tha, tum to khwah-makhwah meri ek awaz par daud pade. Main ne kaha tum ne maan liya, rasoolon ke sachche waade, un ki ba-dalil awaz, un ki kamil hujjat wali dalelein tum ne tark kar dein. Un ki mukhalifat aur meri muwafiqat ki. Jis ka natija aaj apni ankhon se tum ne dekh liya, yeh tumhare apne kartooton ka badla hai, mujhe malamat na karna balki apne nafs ko hi ilzam dena, gunah tumhara apna hai, khud tum ne dalelein chhodein, tum ne meri baat mani, aaj main tumhare kuch kaam na aaunga, na tumhein bacha sakun, na nafa pahuncha sakun. Main to tumhare shirq ke baith tumhara munkir hun, main saf kehta hun ke main shareek-e-Allah nahin, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai: Ayat (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi man la yastajibu lahu) al-akh, is se badh kar gumrah kaun hai? Jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukare, jo qayamat tak us ki pukar ko qubool na kar saken, balki us ke pukarne se mahz ghafil hon aur mahshar ke din un ke dushman aur un ki ibadat ke munkir ban jayen. Aur aayat mein hai: Ayat (Kalla sayakfuruna bi-ibadatihim) al-akh, yaqinan woh log un ki ibadaton se munkir ho jayenge aur un ke dushman ban jayenge. Yeh zalim log hain is liye ke haq se munh pher liya, baatil ke pair-o-kar ban gaye, aise zalimon ke liye alimnak azab hain. Pas zahir hai ke Iblis ka yeh kalam dozakhiyon mein dozakh mein dakhil hone ke baad hoga. Taki woh hasrat-o-afsos mein aur badh jayen. Lekin Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab aglon pichlon ko Allah Ta'ala jama karega aur un mein faisle kar dega, faislon ke waqt aam ghabrahat hogi. Momin kahenge hum mein faisle ho rahe hain, ab hamari sifarish ke liye kaun khada hoga? Pas Hazrat Adam, Hazrat Nuh, Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Musa, Hazrat Isa (Alaihimas Salam) ke paas jayenge. Hazrat Isa farmayenge Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ ke paas pahuncho, chunancha woh mere paas aayenge. Mujhe khada hone ki Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ijazat dega, usi waqt meri majlis se pakeeza, tez aur umdah khushbu phailegi ke us se behtar aur umdah khushbu kabhi kisi ne na sunghi hogi, main chal kar Rabb-ul-Alamin ke paas aunga, mere sar ke baalon se lekar mere pair ke angoothe tak noorani ho jayega. Ab main sifarish karunga aur Janab-e-Haq Tabaraka wa Ta'ala qubool farmayega, yeh dekh kar kafir log kahenge ke chalo bhai hum bhi kisi ko sifarishi bana kar le chalein aur us ke liye hamare paas siwae Iblis ke aur kaun hai? Isi ne hum ko behkaya tha. Chalo usi se arz karein.

aayenge Iblis se kahenge ke mominon ne to shafi' pa liya ab to hamari taraf se shafi' ban ja. Is liye ke hamein gumrah bhi to ne hi kiya hai yeh sun kar yeh mal'oon khara hoga. Us ki majlis se aisi gandi badbu phelegi ke us se pehle kisi naak mein aisi badbu na pohnchi ho. Phir woh kahega jis ka bayaan is aayat mein hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qarzi Rahimahullah farmate hain ke jab jahannami apna sabr aur besabri yaksan batlayenge us waqt Iblis un se yeh kahega us waqt woh apni janon se bhi bezar ho jayenge neda aayegi ke tumhari us waqt ki is bezari se bhi zyada bezari Allah ki tum se us waqt thi jab ke tumhe iman ki taraf bulaya jata tha aur tum kufr karte thay. Aamir Sha'bi Rahimahullah farmate hain tamam logon ke samne us din do shakhs khutba dene ke liye khade honge. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam Alaihis Salam se Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke kya tu ne logon se kaha tha ke tum Allah ke siva mujhe aur meri maan ko ma'bud bana lena yeh aayatein (Haza yaumu yanfa'us-sadiqin) al-akh tak isi bayaan mein hain aur Iblis khara ho kar kahega aayat (Wa ma kana liya 'alaykum min sultanin illa an da'awtukum fastajabtum) (Ibrahim: 22). Bure logon ke anjam ka aur un ke dard-o-gham aur Iblis ke jawab ka zikr farma kar ab naik logon ka anjam bayaan ho raha hai ke iman dar naik aamal log jannaton mein jayenge jahan chahein jayenge aayein chalein phirein khayein piyein hamesha hamesh ke liye wahin rahein. Yahan na azurda hon na dil bhare na tabiyat bhare na mare jayin na nikale jayin na na'matein kam hon. Wahan un ka tuhfa salam hi salam hoga jaise farman hai aayat (Hatta iza ja'uha futihat abwabuhu wa qala lahum khazanatuha alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yatluna 'alaykum ayati Rabbikum wa yundirunakum liqa'a yawmikum) (Az-Zumar: 71), ya'ni jab jannati jannat mein jayenge aur us ke darwaze un ke liye khole jayenge aur wahan ke darogha unhe salam alaik kahenge, al-kh. Aur aayat mein hai har darwaze se un ke pas farishte aayenge aur salam alaik kahenge aur aayat mein hai ke wahan tahiyyah aur salam hi sunaye jayenge. Un ki pukar wahan Allah ki pakeezgi ka bayaan hoga aur un ka tuhfa wahan salam hoga. Aur un ki aakhir aawaz Allah Rabbul-'Alamin ki hamd hogi.

Totā chashm dushman shaitan, Allah Ta'ala jab bandon ki qaza se farigh hoga, momin jannat mein kafir dozakh mein pahunch jayenge, us waqt Iblis maloon jahannam mein khada ho kar un se kahega ke Allah ke waade sachche aur barhaq thay, rasoolon ki tabadari mein hi najat aur salamati thi, mere waade to dhoke thay main to tumhein ghalat rah par dalne ke liye sabz bagh dikhaya karta tha. Meri baatein be-dalil thein, mera kalam be-hujjat tha. Mera koi zor ya ghalba tum par na tha, tum to khwah-makhwah meri ek awaz par daud pade. Main ne kaha tum ne maan liya, rasoolon ke sachche waade, un ki ba-dalil awaz, un ki kamil hujjat wali dalelein tum ne tark kar dein. Un ki mukhalifat aur meri muwafiqat ki. Jis ka natija aaj apni ankhon se tum ne dekh liya, yeh tumhare apne kartooton ka badla hai, mujhe malamat na karna balki apne nafs ko hi ilzam dena, gunah tumhara apna hai, khud tum ne dalelein chhodein, tum ne meri baat mani, aaj main tumhare kuch kaam na aaunga, na tumhein bacha sakun, na nafa pahuncha sakun. Main to tumhare shirq ke baith tumhara munkir hun, main saf kehta hun ke main shareek-e-Allah nahin, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai: Ayat (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi man la yastajibu lahu) al-akh, is se badh kar gumrah kaun hai? Jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukare, jo qayamat tak us ki pukar ko qubool na kar saken, balki us ke pukarne se mahz ghafil hon aur mahshar ke din un ke dushman aur un ki ibadat ke munkir ban jayen. Aur aayat mein hai: Ayat (Kalla sayakfuruna bi-ibadatihim) al-akh, yaqinan woh log un ki ibadaton se munkir ho jayenge aur un ke dushman ban jayenge. Yeh zalim log hain is liye ke haq se munh pher liya, baatil ke pair-o-kar ban gaye, aise zalimon ke liye alimnak azab hain. Pas zahir hai ke Iblis ka yeh kalam dozakhiyon mein dozakh mein dakhil hone ke baad hoga. Taki woh hasrat-o-afsos mein aur badh jayen. Lekin Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab aglon pichlon ko Allah Ta'ala jama karega aur un mein faisle kar dega, faislon ke waqt aam ghabrahat hogi. Momin kahenge hum mein faisle ho rahe hain, ab hamari sifarish ke liye kaun khada hoga? Pas Hazrat Adam, Hazrat Nuh, Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Musa, Hazrat Isa (Alaihimas Salam) ke paas jayenge. Hazrat Isa farmayenge Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ ke paas pahuncho, chunancha woh mere paas aayenge. Mujhe khada hone ki Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ijazat dega, usi waqt meri majlis se pakeeza, tez aur umdah khushbu phailegi ke us se behtar aur umdah khushbu kabhi kisi ne na sunghi hogi, main chal kar Rabb-ul-Alamin ke paas aunga, mere sar ke baalon se lekar mere pair ke angoothe tak noorani ho jayega. Ab main sifarish karunga aur Janab-e-Haq Tabaraka wa Ta'ala qubool farmayega, yeh dekh kar kafir log kahenge ke chalo bhai hum bhi kisi ko sifarishi bana kar le chalein aur us ke liye hamare paas siwae Iblis ke aur kaun hai? Isi ne hum ko behkaya tha. Chalo usi se arz karein.

aayenge Iblis se kahenge ke mominon ne to shafi' pa liya ab to hamari taraf se shafi' ban ja. Is liye ke hamein gumrah bhi to ne hi kiya hai yeh sun kar yeh mal'oon khara hoga. Us ki majlis se aisi gandi badbu phelegi ke us se pehle kisi naak mein aisi badbu na pohnchi ho. Phir woh kahega jis ka bayaan is aayat mein hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qarzi Rahimahullah farmate hain ke jab jahannami apna sabr aur besabri yaksan batlayenge us waqt Iblis un se yeh kahega us waqt woh apni janon se bhi bezar ho jayenge neda aayegi ke tumhari us waqt ki is bezari se bhi zyada bezari Allah ki tum se us waqt thi jab ke tumhe iman ki taraf bulaya jata tha aur tum kufr karte thay. Aamir Sha'bi Rahimahullah farmate hain tamam logon ke samne us din do shakhs khutba dene ke liye khade honge. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam Alaihis Salam se Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke kya tu ne logon se kaha tha ke tum Allah ke siva mujhe aur meri maan ko ma'bud bana lena yeh aayatein (Haza yaumu yanfa'us-sadiqin) al-akh tak isi bayaan mein hain aur Iblis khara ho kar kahega aayat (Wa ma kana liya 'alaykum min sultanin illa an da'awtukum fastajabtum) (Ibrahim: 22). Bure logon ke anjam ka aur un ke dard-o-gham aur Iblis ke jawab ka zikr farma kar ab naik logon ka anjam bayaan ho raha hai ke iman dar naik aamal log jannaton mein jayenge jahan chahein jayenge aayein chalein phirein khayein piyein hamesha hamesh ke liye wahin rahein. Yahan na azurda hon na dil bhare na tabiyat bhare na mare jayin na nikale jayin na na'matein kam hon. La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain. Kalma-e-Tayyiba se murad La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat hai. Pakeeza darakht ki tarah ka momin hai uski jar mazboot hai. Yani momin ke dil mein La Ilaha Illallah jama hua hai uski shakh aasman mein hai. Yani us tawheed ke kalma ki wajah se uske aamal aasman ki taraf uthaye jaate hain aur bhi bohat se mufassireen se yehi marwi hai. Ke murad is se momin ke aamal hain aur uske pak aqwal aur naik kaam. Momin misl khajoor ke darakht ke hai. Har waqt har subh har shaam iske aamal aasman par charhte rehte hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas khajoor ka ek khosha laya gaya. To Aap ne usi ayat ka pehla hissa tilawat farmaya aur farmaya ke pak darakht se murad khajoor ka darakht hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A se manqool hai ke hum Aanhozoor ﷺ ke paas baithe hue the. Jo Aap ne farmaya mujhe batlao woh kaun sa darakht hai jo musalman ke mushabeh hai. Jiske patte nahi jharte na jaron mein na garmiyon mein jo apna phal har mausam mein lata rehta hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain mere dil mein aaya ke keh dun woh darakht khajoor ka hai. Lekin maine dekha ke majlis mein Hazrat Abu Bakr hain Hazrat Umar hain aur woh khamosh hain toh main bhi chup ka ho raha. Aanhazrat ﷺ ne farmaya woh darakht khajoor ka hai. Jab yahan se uthkar chale toh maine apne walid Hazrat Umar R.A se ye zikar kiya. Toh Aap ne farmaya pyare bacche agar tum ye jawab de dete toh mujhe toh tamam cheezon ke mil jaane se bhi zyada mehboob tha. Hazrat Mujahid R.H ka bayan hai ke main Madina Sharif tak Hazrat Ibn Umar R.A ke sath raha lekin siwaye ek hadis ke aur koi riwayat unhe Rasool Allah ﷺ se karte hue nahi suna ismein hai ke ye sawal Aap ne us waqt kiya. Jab Aap ke samne khajoor ke darakht ke beech ka guda laya gaya tha. Main isliye khamosh raha ke main is majlis mein sab se kam umr tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jawab dene walon ka khayal us waqt jangli darakhton ki taraf chala gaya. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke kisi ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se arz kiya ke Huzoor maldar log darjaat mein bohat barh gaye. Aap ne farmaya ke yaad rakho agar tamam duniya ki cheezein lag kar anbar laga do toh bhi woh aasman tak nahi pahunch sakte hain. Tujhe aisa amal batlaon jiski jar mazboot aur jiski shakhein aasman mein hain usne pucha woh kya ? Farmaya dua (La Ilaha Illallah Wallahu Akbar wa SubhanAllah walhamdulillah) har farz namaz ke baad das bar keh liya karo jiski asl mazboot aur jiski fara' aasman mein hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain woh pakeeza darakht jannat mein hai. Har waqt apna phal laye yaani subh shaam ya har mah mein ya har do mah mein ya har shashmahi mein ya har satwein mahine mein ya har saal. Lekin alfaaz ka zahiri matlab toh ye hai ke momin ki misal us darakht jaisi hai jiske phal har waqt jaare garmi mein din raat mein utarte rehte hain usi tarah momin ke naik aamal din raat ke har waqt charhte rehte hain uske Rabb ke hukm se yaani kamil, acche, bohat aur umda.

Allah Ta'ala logon ki ibrat, un ki soch samajh aur un ki naseehat ke liye misalein wazih farmata hai. Phir buray kalima ki yaani kafir ki misal bayan farmai. Jis ki koi asl nahi, jo mazboot nahi, us ki misal andrain ke darakht se di. Jisay hanzal aur shariyan kehte hain. Aik mawqoof riwayat mein Hazrat Anas R.A se bhi aya hai aur yehi riwayat marfoo'an bhi aayi hai. Is darakht ki jar zameen ki teh mein nahi hoti, jhatka mara aur ukhard aya. Isi tarah se kufr be-jar aur be-shakh hai, kafir ka na koi naik amal charhay na maqbool ho.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke musalman se jab uski qabr mein sawal hota hai toh woh gawahi deta hai ke Allah ke siva koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad Rasul Allah hain, yahi murad is ayat ki hai. 

Musnad mein hai ke ek Ansari ke janaze mein hum An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath the, qabristan pohnche, abhi tak qabr tayar na thi. Aap baith gaye aur hum bhi aap ke aas-paas aise baith gaye goya hamare saron par parind hain. Aap ke hath mein jo tinka tha, usse aap zameen par lakeerein nikaal rahe the. Phir sar utha kar do teen martaba farmaya ke azab-e-qabr se Allah ki panah chaho. Banda jab duniya ki aakhirat aur aakhirat ki pehli ghari mein hota hai, toh uske pas aasman se noorani chehre wale farishte aate hain. Goya ke unke chehre suraj jaise hain, unke sath jannati kafan aur jannati khushboo hoti hai. Uske pas jahan tak uski nigah kaam kare wahan tak baith jate hain. Phir Malik-ul-Maut aa kar uske sirhane baith jate hain aur farmate hain, "Aey pak rooh! Allah Ta'ala ki maghfirat aur uski razamandi ki taraf chal." Woh us aasaani se nikal aati hai jaise kisi mashk se pani ka qatra tapak aya ho. Ek aankh jhapne ke barabar ki der hi mein woh farishte use unke hath mein nahi rehne dete, foran le lete hain aur jannati kafan aur jannati khushboo mein rakh lete hain. Khud us rooh mein se bhi mashk se bhi umdah khushboo nikalti hai ke roye zameen par aisi umdah khushboo na soonghi gayi ho. 

Woh use lekar asmanon ki taraf chadhte hain. Farishton ki jis jamat ke pas se guzarte hain, woh puchte hain ke "Yeh pak rooh kis ki hai?" Yeh uska jo behtareen naam duniya mein mashhoor tha, woh batlate hain aur uske baap ka naam bhi. Asman-e-duniya tak pohnch kar darwaze khulwate hain, asman ka darwaza khul jata hai aur wahan ke farishte use doosre asman tak aur doosre asman se teesre asman tak, isi tarah satween asman par woh pohnchta hai. 

Allah Azzawajal farmata hai, "Mere bande ko Kitab-e-Illiyeen mein likh lo aur use zameen ki taraf lota do, maine isi se use paida kiya hai aur isi se dobara nikalunga." 

Pas uski rooh usi ke jism mein lota di jati hai. Uske pas do farishte aate hain, use utha bithaate hain aur sawal karte hain ke "Tera Rab kaun hai?" Woh jawab deta hai, "Allah Ta'ala." 

Phir puchte hain ke "Tera deen kya hai?" Woh jawab deta hai, "Islam." 

Phir sawal hota hai ke "Woh shakhs kaun hai jo tum mein bheja gaya tha?" Yeh kehta hai, "Woh Rasulullah ﷺ the." 

Farishte puchte hain, "Tujhe kaise maloom hua?" Woh kehta hai, "Maine Kitabullah padhi, us par iman laya aur use sacha mana." 

Usi waqt asman se ek munadi neda deta hai ke "Mera banda sacha hai, iske liye jannati farsh bicha do aur jannati libas pehna do aur jannat ki taraf ka darwaza khol do." 

Pas jannat ki rooh-parwar, khushboo-dar hawaon ki laptein use aane lagti hain, uski qabr ba-qadr-e-darazgi-e-nazar ke wasee kar di jati hai. Uske pas ek shakhs khoobsurat, noorani chehre wala, umdah kapdon wala, achhi khushboo wala aata hai aur usse kehta hai...

Aap khush hojayein usi din ka wada aap diye jaate thay. Yeh us se poochta hai ke aap kaun hain? Aap ke chehre se bhalayi hi bhalayi nazar aati hai. Woh jawab deta hai ke tera naik amal hoon. Us waqt musalman aarzoo karta hai ke ya Allah qayamat jald qaim hojaye toh main apne ahl-o-ayaal aur mulk-o-maal ki taraf laut jaoon aur kafir banda jab duniya ki aakhri saaat aur aakhirat ki awal saaat mein hota hai us ke paas siyah chehre ke aasmani farishte aate hain aur un ke sath jahannami taat hota hai jahan tak nigaah pahunche wahan tak woh baith jaate hain phir Hazrat Malik-ul-Maut (A.S) aa kar us ke sarhane baith kar farmate hain ke ae khabeez rooh! Allah Ta'ala ke gazab-o-qahar ki taraf chal. Us ki rooh jism mein chhipti phirti hai jise bahut sakhti ke sath nikala jata hai. Isi waqt ek aankh jhapakne jitni der mein use farishte un ke haathon se le lete hain aur us jahannami bore mein lapet lete hain us mein se aisi badboo nikalti hai ke rooye zameen par is se ziyada badboo nahi payi gayi, ab yeh use lekar upar ko chadhte hain. Farishton ki jis jamaat ke paas se guzarte hain woh poochte hain yeh khabeez rooh kis ki hai? Woh us ka badtareen naam jo duniya mein tha batlate hain aur us ke baap ka naam bhi. Aasman-e-duniya tak pahunch kar darwaza khulwana chahte hain lekin khola nahi jata. Phir Rasool Allah ﷺ ne aayat (La tufattahu lahum abwab-us-sama...) ki tلاوت (tilawat) farmayi ke na un ke liye aasman ke darwaze khulenge na woh jannat mein ja sakenge yahan tak ke soyi ke naake mein se oont guzar jaye. Allah Ta'ala hukam farmata hai ke is ko Kitab-e-Sijjeen mein likh lo jo sab se neeche ki zameen mein hai pas is ki rooh wahin phenk di jati hai. Phir aap ne aayat (Wa man yushrik billahi fa kaannama kharra minas-sama...) ki tilawat farmayi yaani Allah ke sath jo shirk kare goya ke woh aasman se gir pada. Ya toh use parinda uchak le jayenge ya aandhi use kisi door ke gadhe mein phenk maregi. Phir us ki rooh isi jism mein lautayi jati hai us ke paas do farishte pahunchte hain jo use utha bithaate hain aur poochte hain ke tera Rab kaun hai? Woh jawab deta hai ke haaye haaye mujhe nahi maloom. Phir poochte hain tera deen kya hai? Woh kehta hai haaye haaye mujhe is ka bhi ilm nahi. Phir poochte hain woh kaun tha jo tum mein bheja gaya tha? Woh kehta hai haaye haaye mujhe maloom nahi. Isi waqt aasman se ek munadi ki nida aati hai ke mera banda jhoota hai is ke liye jahannam ki aag ka farsh kar do aur dozakh ki janib ka darwaza khol do wahin se use dozakhi hawa aur dozakh ka jhoka pahunchta rehta hai aur us ki qabr us par itni tang hojati hai ke us ki pasliyan ek doosre mein ghus jati hain. Badi buri aur daraavni soorat wala, bare maile-kachile kharab kapron wala, badi badboo wala ek shakhs us ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ab ghamnaak hojayein, usi din ka tujh se wada kiya jata tha. Yeh poochta hai tu kaun hai? Tere chehre se burayi barasti hai. Woh kehta hai main tere bad-amaal ka mujassam hoon, toh yeh dua karta hai ke ya Allah qayamat qaim na ho.

(Abu Dawood, Nasai, Ibn Majah waghera) Musnad mein hai ke naik bande ki rooh nikalne ke waqt aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ke farishte aur aasmanon ke farishte sab us par rahmat bhejte hain aur aasmanon ke darwaze us ke liye khul jate hain, har darwaze ke farishton ki dua hoti hai ke is ki paak aur naik rooh un ke darwaze se charhai jaye Al-Khus, aur bure shakhs ke bare mein is mein hai ke us ki qabr mein ek andha, behra, gonga farishta muqarrar hota hai jis ke hath mein ek gurz hota hai ke agar woh kisi bare pahad par mar diya jaye to woh mitti ban jaye. Is se woh use marta hai, yeh mitti ho jata hai, use Allah Azzawajal phir lautata hai, jaisa tha waisa hi ho jata hai, woh use phir wahi gurz marta hai, yeh aisa chikhta hai ke is ki cheekh ko siwaye insanon aur jinnon ke har koi sunta hai. 

Qabr ka azab: 
Hazrat Bara R.A farmate hain isee ayat se qabr ke azab ka saboot milta hai. Hazrat Abdullah isee ayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain murad is se qabr ke sawalon ke jawab mein Momin ko istiqamat ka milna hai. 

Musnad Abd bin Humaid mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab banda qabr mein rakha jata hai, log munh pherte hain, abhi un ki wapsi ki chaal ki jootiyon ki aahat us ke kanon hi mein hai ke do farishte us ke paas pahunch kar use bitha kar puchte hain ke is shakhs ke bare mein tu kya kahta hai? Momin jawab deta hai ke meri gawahi hai ke woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain, to use kaha jata hai ke dekh, Jahannam mein tera yeh thikana tha, lekin ab ise badal kar Allah ne Jannat ki yeh jagah tujhe inayat farmai hai. Farmate hain ke use donon jagah nazar aati hain. 

Hazrat Qatada R.H ka farman hai ke is ki qabr sattar gaz chaudi kar di jati hai aur Qiyamat tak sarsabzi se bhari rahti hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ke is ummat ki aazmaish un ki qabron mein se hoti hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Momin us waqt aarzoo karta hai ke mujhe chhor do, main apne logon ko yeh khushkhabri suna dun, woh kahte hain theher jao. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke munafiq ko bhi us ki donon jagah dikha di jati hain. Farmate hain ke har shakhs jis par mara hai isee par uthaya jata hai, Momin apne iman par, munafiq apne nifaq par. 

Musnad Ahmad ki riwayat mein hai ke farishta jo aata hai us ke hath mein lohe ka hathoda hota hai, Momin Allah ki maboodiyat aur tawheed ki aur Muhammad ﷺ ki abdiyat aur risalat ki gawahi deta hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke apna Jannat ka makan dekh kar us mein jana chahta hai, lekin use kaha jata hai: "Abhi yehi aaram karo." Is ke aakhir mein hai ke Sahaba R.A ne kaha: "Ya RasoolAllah! Jab ek farishte ko hath mein gurz liye dekhenge to hawas kaise qaim rahenge?" To Aap ﷺ ne yehi ayat parhi, yani Allah ki taraf se unhein sabit-qadmi milti hai. 

Aur Hadees mein hai ke rooh nikalne ke waqt Momin se kaha jata hai ke aey itminan wali rooh jo paak jism mein thi! Nikal taarifon wali ho kar aur khush ho ja, rahat-o-aaram aur phal phool aur Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ki rahmat ke sath.

Ismein hai ke aasman ke farishte us rooh ko marhaba kehte hain aur yahi khushkhabri sunate hain. Ismein hai ke bure insan ki rooh ko kaha jata hai ke ae khabees rooh jo khabees jism mein thi nikal buri ban kar aur tayyar hoja aag jaisa pani pine ke liye aur lahu peep khane ke liye aur usi jaise aur beshumar azabon ke liye, ismein hai ke aasman ke farishte us ke liye darwaza nahi kholte aur kehte hain buri ho kar muzammat ke sath laut ja tere liye darwaze nahi khulenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aasmani farishte naik rooh ke liye kehte hain Allah tujh par rahmat kare aur us jism par bhi jis mein tu thi. Yahan tak ke use Allah Azzawajal ke pas pahunchate hain wahan se irshad hota hai ke ise aakhri muddat ke liye le jao. Ismein hai ke kafir ki rooh ki badboo ka bayan karte hue Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apni chadar mubarak apni naak par rakh li aur riwayat mein hai ke rahmat ke farishte momin ki rooh ke liye Jannati safed resham lekar utarte hain. Ek ek ke hath se us rooh ko lena chahta hai. Jab yeh pehle ke momino ki arwah se milti hai, to jaise koi naya aadmi safar se aaye aur uske ghar wale khush hote hain us se zyada yeh roheN us rooh se mil kar raazi hoti hain phir puchti hain ke falan ka kya haal hai? Lekin un mein se baaz kehte hain ke abhi sawal jawab na karo zara aaram to kar lene do. Yeh to gham se abhi hi chhooti hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke kafir ki rooh ko jab zameen ke darwaze ke pas laate hain to wahan darogha farishte us ki badboo se ghabrate hain aakhir ise sab se neeche ki zameen mein pahunchate hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr ؓ farmate hain ke momino ki roheN jabin mein aur kafiro ki roheN barhoot nami hazramoot ke qaidkhane mein jama rehti hain. Us ki qabar bohat tang hojati hai. Tirmizi mein hai ke mayyat ke qabar mein rakhe jaane ke bad uske pas do siyah faam neeli aankhon wale farishte aate hain ek Munkar doosra Nakeer. Us ke jawab ko sun kar woh kehte hain ke hamein ilm tha ke tum aise hi jawab doge phir us ki qabar kushada kar di jati hai aur noorani bana di jati hai. Aur kaha jata hai soja. Yeh kehta hai ke main to apne ghar walon se kahunga. Lekin woh dono kehte hain ke dulhan ki si be-fikri ki neend so ja. Jise uske ahl mein se wahi jagata hai jo use sab se zyada pyara ho. Yahan tak ke Allah khud use is khwabgah se jagaye. Munafiq jawab mein kehta hai ke log jo kuch kehte the main bhi kehta raha lekin jaanta nahi. Woh kehte hain hum to jaante hi the ke tera yeh jawab hoga. Usi waqt zameen ko hukum diya jata hai ke simat ja. Woh simat jati hai yahan tak ke us ki pasliyan idhar udhar ghus jati hain phir use azab hota rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala qiyamat qayam kare aur use us ki qabar se uthaye aur hadees mein hai ke momin ke jawab par kaha jata hai ke isi par to jiya isi par teri maut hui aur isi par to uthaya jayega. Ibn Jareer mein farman-e-Rasool Kareem ﷺ hai.

Us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke mayyat tumhari jootiyon ki aahat sunti hai jab ke tum usay dafna kar wapas lauthtay ho agar woh iman par mara hai toh namaz us ke sarhanay hoti hai, zakat dayen janib hoti hai, roza bayen taraf hota hai. Nekiyan maslan sadqa khairat sila rahmi bhalai logon se ihsan waghera us ke pairon ki taraf hotay hain, jab us ke sar ki taraf se koi aata hai toh namaz kehti hai yahan se janay ki jagah nahi. Dayen taraf se zakat rokti hai. Bayen taraf se roza. Pairon ki taraf se aur nekiyan. Pas us se kaha jata hai baith jaao. Woh baith jata hai aur usay aisa maloom deta hai ke goya sooraj doobne ke qareeb hai. Woh kehte hain ke dekho jo hum poochen us ka jawab do. Woh kehta hai tum chhoro pehle main namaz ada kar loon. Woh kehte hain woh toh tu karega hi. Abhi toh humein hamaray sawalon ka jawab de. Woh kehta hai achha tum kya poochtay ho? Woh kehte hain is shakhs ke baray mein tu kya kehta hai aur kya shahadat deta hai. Woh poochta hai kya Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke baray mein? Jawab milta hai ke haan aap hi ke baray mein yeh kehta hai ke meri gawahi hai ke aap Rasoolullah hain, aap Allah ke paas se hamaray paas dalelein lekar aaye, hum ne aap ko sacha mana. Phir us se kaha jata hai ke tu isi par zinda rakha gaya aur isi par mara aur Insha'Allah isi par dobara uthaya jayega. Phir us ki qabr sattar haath phaila di jati hai aur noorani kar di jati hai aur Jannat ki taraf ek darwaza khol diya jata hai aur kaha jata hai dekh yeh hai tera asli thikana. Ab tu isay khushi aur rahat hi rahat hoti hai. Phir us ki rooh pak roohoon mein sabz parindon ke qaalib mein jannati darakhton mein rehti hai. Aur us ka jism jis se us ki ibtida ki gayi thi isi taraf luta diya jata hai. Yaani mitti ki taraf, yahi is ayat ka matlab hai aur riwayat mein hai ke maut ke waqt ki rahat aur noor ko dekh kar momin apni rooh ke nikal janay ki tamanna karta hai aur Allah ko bhi isi ki mulaqat mehboob hoti hai. Jab us ki rooh aasman par charh jati hai toh us ke paas mominon ki aur roohein aati hain aur apni jaan pehchan ke logon ki baabat us se sawalaat kartay hain. Agar yeh kehta hai ke falan toh zinda hai toh khair. Aur agar yeh kehta hai ke falan toh mar chuka hai toh yeh naraz ho kar kehte hain yahan nahi laya gaya. Momin ko us ki qabr mein bitha diya jata hai. Phir us se poochha jata hai. Tera nabi kaun hai? Yeh kehta hai mere Nabi Muhammad ﷺ hain. Farishta kehta hai ke tera deen kya hai? Yeh jawab deta hai mera deen Islam hai. Isi mein hai ke Allah ke dushman ko jab maut anay lagti hai aur yeh Allah ki narazgi ke asbaab dekh leta hai toh nahi chahta ke us ki rooh nikle. Allah bhi us ki mulaqat se na-khush hota hai. Is mein hai ke usay sawal jawab aur maar-peet ke baad kaha jata hai aisa so jaise saanp kata huwa. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh Huzoor ﷺ ki risalat ki gawahi deta hai toh farishta kehta hai ke tujhe kaise maloom ho gaya kya tu ne aap ke zamanay ko paya hai?

Is mein hai ke kafir ki qabar mein aisa behra farishta azaab karne wala hota hai ke jo na kabhi sune na rahem kare. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain maut ke waqt momin ke paas farishte aa kar salam karte hain jannat ki basharat dete hain is ke janaze ke sath chalte hain logon ke sath is ke janaze ki namaz mein شرکت (shirkat) karte hain. Is mein hai ke kafiron ke paas farishte aate hain. In ke chehron par in ki kamar par maar marte hain. Use is ki qabar mein jawab bhula diya jata hai. Isi tarah zalimon ko Allah gumrah kar deta hai. Hazrat Abu Qatada Ansari R.A se bhi aisa hi qaul marwi hai. Is mein hai ke momin kahta hai ke mere nabi Hazrat Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ hain kayi dafa is se sawal hota hai aur yeh yahi jawab deta hai ise jahannam ka thikana dikha kar kaha jata hai ke agar tedha chalta to teri yeh jagah thi. Aur jannat ka thikana dikha kar kaha jata hai ke tauba ki wajah se yeh thikana hai. Hazrat Tawus R.H farmate hain duniya mein sabit qadami kalma-e-tauheed par istiqamat hai aur aakhirat mein sabit qadami Munkar-Nakir ke jawab ki hai. Qatada R.H farmate hain khair aur amal-e-salih ke sath duniya mein rakhe jate hain aur qabar mein bhi. Abu Abdullah Hakim Tirmizi apni kitab Nawadir-ul-Usool mein laaye hain ke sahaba ki jamaat ke paas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ne Madina ki masjid mein farmaya ke guzishta raat mein ne ajeeb baatein dekhiin dekha ke mere ek ummati ko azaab-e-qabar ne gher rakha hai aakhir is ke wuzu ne aa kar ise chuda liya mere ek ummati ko dekha ke shaitan ise wahshi banaye hue hain lekin zikrullah ne aa kar ise khalasi dilwayi. Ek ummati ko dekha ke azaab ke farishton ne ise gher rakha hai. Is ki namaz ne aa kar ise bacha liya. Ek ummati ko dekha ke pyas ke maare halak ho raha hai jab hauz par jata hai dhakke lagte hain. Is ka roza aaya aur is ne ise pani pila diya aur aasuda kar diya. Aap ne ek aur ummati ko dekha ke anbiya halqe bandh bandh kar baithe hain yeh jis halqe mein baithna chahta hai wahan wale ise utha dete hain. Isi waqt is ka janabat ka ghusl aaya aur is ka hath pakad kar mere paas bitha diya. Ek ummati ko dekha ke charon taraf se ise andhera ghere hue hain aur upar niche se bhi woh isi mein ghira huwa hai jo is ka hajj aur umrah aaya aur ise is andhere mein se nikal kar noor mein pahuncha diya. Ek ummati ko dekha ke woh mominon se kalam karna chahta hai lekin woh is se bolte nahi isi waqt silah rahmi aayi aur elan kiya ke is se baat cheet karo chunacha woh bolne chalne lage ek ummati ko dekha ke woh apne munh par se aag ke sholay hatane ko hath badha raha hai itne mein is ki khairaat aayi aur is ke munh par parda aur out ho gayi aur is ke sar par saya ban gayi apne ek ummati ko dekha ke azaab ke farishton ne ise har taraf se qaid kar liya hai. Lekin is ka neki ka hukum aur burai se mana karna aaya aur in ke hathon se chuda kar rahmat ke farishton se mila diya. Apne ek ek ummati ko dekha ke ghutnon ke bal gira huwa hai.

aur Allah mein aur us mein hijaab hai us ke achhe akhlaaq aaye aur uska haath pakad kar Allah ke paas pahuncha aaye. Apne ek ummati ko dekha ke uska naama-e-aamal uski baayin taraf se aa raha hai lekin uske khauf-e-ilahi ne aa kar use uske samne kardiya. Apne ek ummati ko main ne jahannam ke kinare khada dekha usi waqt uska Allah se kapkapana aaya aur use jahannam se bacha le gaya. Main ne ek ummati ko dekha ke pul siraat par ludhkaniyan kha raha hai ke uska mujh par durood padhana aaya aur haath thaam kar seedha kardiya. Aur woh paar utar gaya ek ko dekha ke jannat ke darwaze par pahuncha lekin darwaza band hogaya. Usi waqt La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat pahunchi darwaze khulwa diye aur use jannat mein pahuncha diya. Qurtubi is hadis ko وارد kar ke farmate hain yeh hadis bahut badi hai is mein un makhsoos amaal ka zikr hai jo makhsoos museebaton se nijaat dilwane wale hain (Tazkirah). Isi bare mein Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mosili (Rahimahullah) ne bhi ek ghareeb mutawwal hadis riwayat ki hai jis mein hai ke Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala Malik-ul-Maut se farmata hai tu mere dost ke paas ja. Main ne use asani aur sakhti dono tarah se aazma liya har ek halat mein use apni khushi mein khush paya to ja aur use mere paas le aa. Ke main use har tarah ka aaram-o-aish dun. Malik-ul-Maut (Alaihis Salam) apne sath paanch sau farishton ko le kar chalte hain unke paas jannati kafan wahan ki khushbu aur raihan ke khushe hote hain jis ke sire par bees rang hote hain har rang ki khushbu alag alag hoti hai safed reshmi kapde mein aala mushk ba takalluf lipti hui hoti hai yeh sab aate hain Malik-ul-Maut (Alaihis Salam) to us ke sirhane baith jate hain aur farishte us ke charon taraf baith jate hain har ek ke sath jo kuch jannati tuhfa hai woh us ke aza par rakh diya jata hai aur safed resham aur mushk-e-azfar us ki thodi tale rakh diya jata hai us ke liye jannat ke darwaze khol diye jate hain aur us ki rooh kabhi jannati phoolon se kabhi jannati libasoon se kabhi jannati phalon se is tarah behlayi jati hai jaise rote hue bachha ko log behlate hain. Us waqt uski hoorein hans hans kar uski chahat karti hain rooh in manazir ko dekh kar bahut jald jismani qaid se nikal jane ka qasd karti hai Malik-ul-Maut farmate hain haan aey paak rooh baghair kaante ki beriyon ki taraf aur lade hue kelon ki taraf aur lambi lambi chhaon ki taraf aur pani ke jharnon ki taraf chal. Wallahu maa jis qadr bachche par meharban hoti hai is se bhi zyada Malik-ul-Maut us par shafaqat-o-rahmat karta hai. Is liye ke use ilm hai ke yeh mehboob-e-ilahi hai agar use zara si bhi takleef pahunchi to mere Rab ki narazgi mujh par hogi. Bas is tarah us rooh ko is jism se alag karleta hai jaise gundhe hue aate mein se baal. Inhi ke bare mein farman-e-ilahi hai ke unki rooh ko paak farishte faut karte hain. Aur jagah farman hai ke agar woh muqarrabein mein se hai to us ke liye aaram-o-aasayish hai. Yani maut aaram ki aur aasayish ki milne wali aur duniya ke badle ki jannat hai.

Malik-ul-Maut ke ruh ko qabz karte hi ruh jism se कहती hai ke Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal tujhe jazaye khair de, tu Allah ki itaat ki taraf jaldi karne wala aur Allah ki masiyat se der karne wala tha. Tune aap bhi najat paayi aur mujhe bhi najat dilwaayi. Jism bhi ruh ko aisa hi jawab deta hai. Zameen ke woh tamam hisse jin par yeh ibadat-e-Ilahi karta tha, uske marne se chaalis din tak rote hain, isi tarah asmaan ke woh kul darwaze jin se iske nek amaal chadhte the aur jin se iski roziyan utarti thin, is par rote hain. 

Us waqt woh paanch sau farishte is jism ke ird-gird khade hojate hain aur iske nehlane mein shamil rehte hain. Insan iski karwat badle, isse pehle khud farishte badal dete hain aur ise nehla kar insani kafan se pehle apna sath laya hua kafan pehna dete hain, unki khushbu se pehle apni khushbu laga dete hain aur iske ghar ke darwaze se lekar iski qabr tak do tarfa safein bandh kar khade hojate hain aur iske liye istighfar karne lagte hain. 

Us waqt shaitan is zor ke sath ranj ke sath chillata hai ke iske jism ki haddiyan toot jaayen aur kehta hai: "Mere lashkariyo, tum barbad ho jao, haye yeh tumhare hathon se kaise bach gaya?" Woh jawab dete hain ke: "Yeh to masoom tha." 

Jab iski ruh ko lekar Malik-ul-Maut chadhte hain, to Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) sattar hazaar farishton ko lekar iska istiqbal karte hain, har ek ise judgana basharat-e-Ilahi sunata hai, yahan tak ke iski ruh Arsh-e-Ilahi ke paas pahunchti hai, wahan jate hi sajde mein gir padti hai. Usi waqt Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hota hai: "Mere bande ki ruh ko baghair kanton ki beeron mein aur teh-ba-teh keelon ke darakhton mein aur lambe lambe sayon mein aur behte paniyon mein jagah do." 

Phir jab ise qabr mein rakha jata hai, to dayen taraf namaz khadi hojati hai, bayen janib roza khada hojati hai, sir ki taraf Quran aa jata hai, namazon ko chal kar jana pairon ki taraf hota hai, ek kinare sabr khada hojata hai. Azab ki ek gardan lapakti aati hai, lekin dayen janib se namaz ise rok deti hai ke yeh hamesha chokna raha, ab is qabr mein aa kar zara rahat paayi hai. Woh bayen taraf se aati hai, yahan se roza yehi keh kar ise aane nahi deta. Sirhane se aati hai, yahan se Quran aur zikr yehi keh kar aade aate hain. Woh payantiyon se aati hai, yahan ise iska namazon ke liye chal kar jana ise rok deta hai. 

Gharz charon taraf se Allah ke mahboob ke liye rok hojati hai aur azab ko kahin se rah nahi milti, woh wapas chala jata hai. Us waqt sabr kehta hai ke: "Main dekh raha tha ke agar tum se hi yeh azab dafa hojaye to mujhe bolne ki kya zarurat? Warna main bhi iski himayat karta, ab main pul sirat par aur mizan ke waqt iske kaam aunga." 

Ab do farishte bheje jate hain, ek ko Nakeer kaha jata hai, dusre ko Munkar.

Yeh uchak le jaane wali bijli jaise hote hain, unke daant siyah jaise hote hain, unke saans se sholay nikalte hain, unke baal pairon tale latakte hote hain, unke do kandhon ke darmiyan itni itni masafat hoti hai. Unke dil narmi aur rahmat se bilkul khali hote hain, un mein se har ek ke haath mein hathoray hote hain ke agar qabila Rabia aur qabila Mudar jama ho kar ise uthana chahein toh namumkin. Woh aate hi ise kehte hain uth baith. Yeh uth kar seedhe tarah baith jata hai, uska kafan uske pehlu par aa jata hai, woh usse puchte hain tera Rabb kaun hai? Tera deen kya hai? Tera nabi kaun hai? Sahaba se na raha gaya, unhon ne kaha, Ya Rasoolallah aise daraune farishton ko kaun jawab de sakega? Aap ne isi ayat (يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ ۚ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظَّالِمِيْنَ ۙ وَيَفْعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَاءُ - 14. (Ibrahim: 27) ki tilawat farmayi aur farmaya: Woh be-jhijhak jawab deta hai ke mera Rabb Allah wahdahu la sharika lah hai aur mera deen Islam hai jo farishton ka bhi deen hai aur mere Nabi Muhammad hain jo Khatam-ul-Anbiya the ﷺ. Woh kehte hain aap ne sahi jawab diya. Ab toh woh uske liye uski qabr ko uske aage se, uske daayein se, uske baayein se, uske peechhe se, uske sar ki taraf se, uske paon ki taraf se chaalis chaalis haath kushada kar dete hain, do sau haath ki wus'at kar dete hain aur chaalis haath ka ihata kar dete hain aur usse farmaate hain: Apne upar nazrein utha. Yeh dekhta hai ke jannat ka darwaza khula hua hai. Woh kehte hain: Ae Allah ke dost! Chunke tune Allah ki baat maan li, teri manzil yeh hai. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Us Allah ki kasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, us waqt jo suroor-o-rahat uske dil ko hoti hai, woh lazawal hoti hai. Phir usse kaha jata hai: Ab apne neeche ki taraf dekh. Yeh dekhta hai ke jahannam ka darwaza khula hua hai. Farishtey kehte hain ke dekh isse Allah ne tujhe hamesha ke liye nijat bakshi. Phir toh uska dil itna khush hota hai ke yeh khushi abad-ul-abad tak hatti nahi. Hazrat Ayesha ؓ farmati hain ke uske liye sattar darwaze jannat ke khul jaate hain jahan se baad-e-saba ki laptein khushboo aur thandak ke sath aati rehti hain yahan tak ke ise Allah Azza wa Jal uski is khwab-gah se qayamat ke qaim ho jaane par uthaye. Isi isnad se marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala bure bande ke liye Malakul Maut se farmata hai: Ja aur is mere dushman ko le aa. Ise maine teri zindagi mein barkat de rakhi thi, apni neamatein ata farma rakhi thin lekin phir bhi yeh meri nafarmaniyon se na bacha, ise le aa taake main isse intiqam loon. Isi waqt Hazrat Malakul Maut Alaihis Salam uske samne intehai bad aur darauni soorat mein aate hain, aisi ke kisi ne itni bhayanak aur ghanauni soorat na dekhi ho, barah aankhein hoti hain, jahannam ka khar-dar libas sath hota hai, paanch sau farishte jo jahannami aag ke angarey aur aag ke koray apne sath liye hue hote hain, unke sath hote hain.

Malik-ul-Maut woh khar-dar khaal jo jahannam ki aag ki hai us ke jism par marte hain, rooyen rooyen mein aag ke kante ghus jate hain, phir is tarah ghumate hain ke us ka jor jor dheela par jata hai, phir us ki rooh us ke paon ke angothon se kheenchte hain aur us ke ghutnon par daal dete hain. Us waqt Allah ka dushman behosh ho jata hai, pas Malik-ul-Maut usse utha lete hain, farishte apne jahannami kore us ke chehre par aur peeth par marte hain, phir us ke teh-band bandhne ki jagah par daal dete hain. Yeh dushman-e-Rab us waqt phir betaab ho jata hai, farishta-e-maut phir us behoshi ko utha leta hai aur farishte phir us ke chehre par aur kamar par kore barsane lagte hain. Aakhir yahan tak ke rooh seene par charh jati hai, phir halaq tak pohanchti hai, phir farishte jahannami tambe aur jahannami angaron ko us ki thori ke niche rakh dete hain aur Malik-ul-Maut (A.S) farmate hain: "Aaye la'in-o-mal'oon rooh! Chal seenk mein aur jhalste pani aur kale siyah dhuwein ke ghubar mein jis mein na to khunki hai na achchi jagah." 

Jab yeh rooh qabz ho jati hai to apne jism se kehti hai: "Allah tujh se samjhe, tu mujhe Allah ki na-farmaniyon ki taraf bhagaye liye ja raha tha, khud bhi halak huwa aur mujhe bhi barbad kiya." Jism bhi rooh se yahi kehta hai. Zameen ke woh tamam hisse jahan yeh Allah ki ma'siyat karta tha is par la'nat karne lagte hain. Shaitani lashkar daorta huwa shaitan ke paas pohanchta hai aur kehta hai ke hum ne aaj ek ko jahannam mein pohancha diya. 

Is ki qabr is qadar tang ho jati hai ke is ki dayen pasliyan bayen mein aur bayen dayen mein ghus jati hain. Kale naag bakhti oonton ke barabar is ki qabr mein bheje jate hain jo is ke kanon aur is ke paon ke angothon se usse dasna shuru karte hain aur oopar charhte aate hain yahan tak ke wasat-e-jism mein mil jate hain. 

Do farishte bheje jate hain jin ki aankhein tez bijli jaisi, jin ki aawaz garaj jaisi, jin ke daant darande jaise, jin ke lance aag ke sholay jaise, jin ke baal pairon ke niche tak, jin ke do mondhon ke darmiyan itni itni masafat hai, jin ke dil mein rahmat-o-rahm ka naam-o-nishaan bhi nahi, jin ka naam hi Munkar Nakeer hai, jin ke haath mein lohe ke itne bare hathore hain jinhein Rabi'a aur Mazaram mil kar bhi nahi utha sakte. Woh usse kehte hain: "Uth baith!" Yeh seedha baith jata hai aur teh-band bandhne ki jagah is ka kafan aa parhta hai. Woh usse puchte hain: "Tera Rab kaun hai? Tera deen kya hai? Tera Nabi kaun hai?" Yeh kehta hai: "Mujhe to kuch khabar nahi." Woh kehte hain: "Haan, na tune maloom kiya na tune parha!" Phir is zor se usse hathora marte hain ke us ke sharare us ki qabr ko pur kar dete hain. Phir laut kar us se kehte hain: "Apne oopar ko dekh!" Yeh ek khula huwa darwaza dekhta hai. Woh kehte hain: "Wallah! Agar tu Allah ka farmanbardar rehta to teri yeh jagah thi." 

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: "Ab to usse woh hasrat hoti hai jo kabhi us ke dil se juda nahi hone ki."

Phir woh kehte hain ab apne neeche dekh, woh dekhta hai ke ek darwaza jahannam ka khula hua hai, farishte kehte hain aye dushman-e-Rabb, chunke tu ne Allah ki marzi ke khilaaf kaam kiye hain, ab teri jagah yeh hai. Wallah, us waqt uska dil ranj-o-afsos se baith jata hai jo sadma use kabhi bhoolne ka nahi. Uske liye sattar darwaze jahannam ke khul jate hain jahan se garam hawa aur bhaap use hamesha hi aya karti hai, yahan tak ke use Allah Ta'ala utha bithaaye. 

Yeh hadith bahut gharib hai aur yeh siyaq bahut ajeeb hai, aur iska rawi Yazeed Raqqaasi jo Hazrat Anas R.A ke neeche ka rawi hai, iski gharaib-o-munkarat bahut hain aur aimmah ke nazdeek woh zaeef-ur-riwayat hai, Wallah A'lam. 

Abu Dawood mein hai, Hazrat Usman R.A farmate hain ke jab Rasool Allah ﷺ kisi shakhs ke dafan se farigh hote to wahan thehar jate aur farmate: Apne bhai ke liye istighfar karo aur uske liye sabit-qadami talab karo, us waqt usse sawal ho raha hai. 

Hafiz Ibn Mardooyah ne farman-e-Bari (Wa lau tara iziz-zalimona fi ghamarat-il-mawti...) [Surah Al-An'am: 93] ki tafseer mein ek bahut lambi hadith وارد ki hai, woh bhi gharaib se pur hai.)

Munafiqeen-e-Quresh: Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke "Alam Tara" ma'ani mein "Alam Ta'alam" ke hai yaani kya tu nahi jaanta. "Buwar" ke ma'ani halakat ke hain, ba-ri-bour, "Bour" ke ma'ani halikeen ke hain. Murad in logon se bi-qaul-e-Ibn Abbas (R.A) kuffar-e-Ahl-e-Makkah hain, aur ek qol yeh hai ke murad is se Jabla bin Aiham aur us ki itaat karne wale woh Arab hain jo Rumiyon se mil gaye the lekin mashhoor aur sahih qol Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka awwal hi hai, go alfaaz apne umoom ke aitbaar se tamam kuffar par mushtamil hon.

Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tamam aalam ke liye rehmat bana kar aur kul logon ke liye nemat bana kar bheja hai, jis ne is rehmat-o-nemat ki qadardani ki woh jannati hai aur jis ne na-qadri ki woh jahannami hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi ek qol Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke pehle qol ki muwafiqat mein marwi hai. Ibn al-Kawa ke jawab mein aap ne yahi farmaya tha ke yeh Badr ke din ke kuffar-e-Quresh hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek shakhs ke sawal par aap ne farmaya murad is se munafiqeen-e-Quresh hain.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek martaba farmaya ke kya mujh se Quran ki baabat koi kuch baat daryaft nahi karta? Wallah mere ilm mein agar aaj koi mujh se zyada Quran ka alim hota to chahe woh samandaron paar hota lekin main zaroor us ke paas pahunchta. Yeh sun kar Abdullah bin al-Kawa khada ho gaya aur kaha yeh kaun log hain jin ke baare mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke unhon ne Allah ki nemat-e-imaan paayi lekin us nemat ko kufr se badla aur apni kaum ko halakat ke garhe mein daal diya? Aap ne farmaya yeh mushrikeen-e-Quresh hain, un ke paas Allah ki nemat-e-imaan pahunchi lekin us nemat ko unhon ne kufr se badal diya.

Aur riwayat mein aap se marwi hai ke is se murad Quresh ke do fajir hain: Banu Umayyah aur Banu Mughirah. Banu Mughirah ne apni kaum ko Badr mein la khara kiya aur unhein halakat mein dala aur Banu Umayyah ne Uhud wale din apne walon ko ghaarat kiya. Badr mein Abu Jahl tha aur Uhud mein Abu Sufyan, aur halakat ke ghar se murad Jahannam hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Banu Mughirah to Badr mein halak hue aur Banu Umayyah ko kuch dinon ka faida mil gaya.

Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi is ayat ki tafseer mein yahi marwi hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne jab aap se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya yeh dono Quresh ke badkaar hain; mere mamoon aur tere chacha, meri mamiyan wale to Badr ke din na-paed ho gaye aur tere chacha walon ko Allah ne mohlat de rakhi hai, yeh Jahannam mein jayenge jo buri jagah hai. Unhon ne khud shirk kiya aur doosron ko shirk ki taraf bulaya.

Aaye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum in se keh do ke duniya mein kuch kha pi lo, pehan orh lo, aakhir thikana to tumhara Jahannam hai. Jaise farman hai: Hum unhein yunhi sa aaram de denge phir sakht azabon ki taraf be-bas kar denge. Dunyawi nafa agarche hoga lekin lautenge to hamari hi taraf, us waqt hum unhein un ke kufr ki wajah se sakht azab karenge.
