Ihsan aur Ahsan-e-Suluk:
Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko apni ita'at ka, aur apne haq manne ka, aur makhlooq-e-Rabb se ihsan-o-suluk karne ka hukum de raha hai. Farmata hai ke namaz barabar padhte rahein jo Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat hai aur zakat zaroor dete rahein, qarabat daron ko bhi aur anjan logon ko bhi. Iqamat se murad waqt ki, had ki, ruku ki, khushoo ki, sajde ki hifazat karna hai. Allah ki di hui rozi uski rah mein poshida aur khule taur par uski khushnudi ke liye auron ko bhi deni chahiye taake us din nijajat mile jis din koi khareedo-farokht na hogi na koi dosti ashnaayi hogi. Koi apne aap ko ba-taur fidye ke bechna bhi chahe to bhi namumkin. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Fa-al-yauma la yu'khazu minkum fidyatun wa la minallazina kafaru ma'wakumun-nar hiya maulaakum wa bi'sal-maseer - 57. (Al-Hadid: 15) yani aaj tum se aur kafiron se koi fidyah aur badla na liya jayega. Wahan kisi ki dosti ki wajah se koi chhute ga nahi balke wahan adl-o-insaf hi hoga. Khilal masdar hai. Imra-ul-Qais ke sher mein bhi yeh lafz hai. Duniya mein len-den, mohabbat dosti kaam aa jati hai lekin wahan yeh cheez agar Allah ke liye na ho to mahz be-sood rahegi. Koi saudagari, koi shnasa wahan kaam na aayegi. Zameen bhar kar sona fidye mein dena chahe lekin radd hai, kisi ki dosti kisi ki sifarish kafir ko kaam na degi. Farman-e-Ilahi hai ayat: (Wa-ittaqu yauman la tajzi nafsun ‘an nafsin shai'an wa la yuqbalu minha shafaa'atun wa la yu'khazu minha ‘adlun wa la hum yunsarun - 2. (Al-Baqarah: 48) Us din ke azab se bachne ki koshish karo, jis din koi kisi ko kuch kaam na aayega, na kisi se fidyah qubool kiya jayega, na kisi ko kisi ki shafa'at nafa' degi na koi kisi ki madad kar sakega. Farman hai ayat: (Ya ayyuhal-lazina amanu anfitu mimma razaqnakum min qabli an ya'tiya yaumun la ba'yun fihi wa la khullatun wa la shafa'atun wal-kafiruna humuz-zalimun - 2. (Al-Baqarah: 254) Imaan daro! Jo hum ne tumhe de rakha hai, tum us mein se hamari rah mein kharch karo us se pehle ke woh din aaye jis mein na byopar hai, na dosti, na shafa'at. Kafir hi darasal zalim hain.)))

Sab kuch tumhara mutii hai Allah ki tarah tarah ki beshumar naimaton ko dekho. Asman ko is ne aik mehfooz chat bana rakha hai zameen ko behtreen farsh bana rakha hai asman se barish barsa kar zameen se maze maze ke phal khetiyan baghat tayyar kar deta hai. Isi ke hukm ke mutabiq kashtiyan pani ke ooper tirti phirti hain ke tumheen aik kinare se doosray kinare aur aik mulk se doosray mulk pohanchayen tum wahan ka maal yahan, yahan ka wahan le jao, le aao, nafa hasil karo, tajurba barhao. Nahrein bhi isi ne tumhare kaam mein laga rakhi hain, tum un ka pani piyo, pilao, is se khetiyan karo, nahao dho-o aur tarah tarah ke faide hasil karo. Hamesha chalte phirte aur kabhi na thakte sooraj chand bhi tumhare faide ke kaamo mein mashghool hain muqarrar chaal par muqarrar jagah par gardish mein lage hue hain. Na un mein takrar ho na aaga pecha, din raat unhi ke aane jaane se pe dar pe aate jaate rehte hain sitaray isi ke hukm ke matahet hain aur Rab-ul-Aalameen babarkat hai. Kabhi dinon ko bare kar deta hai kabhi ratoon ko barha deta hai, har cheez apne kaam mein sar jhukaye mashghool hai, woh Allah Azeez-o-Ghaffar hai. Tumhari zaroorat ki tamam cheezein is ne tumhare liye mohayya kar di hain tum apne haal-o-qaal se jin jin cheezein ke mohtaj thay, is ne sab kuch tumheen de di hain, mangne par bhi woh deta hai aur be-mange bhi is ka haath nahi rukta. Hurmat-o-Azmat ka Malik shahar Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki hurmat wala shahar Makkah ibtida mein Allah ki tawheed par hi banaya gaya tha. Us ke awal bani Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) Allah ke siva auron ki ibadat karne walon se bari thay. Unhi ne is shahar ke ba-aman hone ki dua ki thi. Jo Allah Ta'ala ne qubul farmai. Sab se pehla babarkat aur ba-hidayat Allah ka ghar Makkah Sharif ka hi hai, jis mein bahut si wazih nishaniyon ke alawa Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai. Is shahar mein jo pahunch gaya, amn-o-aman mein aagaya. 

Is shahar ko banane ke baad Khalilullah ne dua ki ki Aue Allah is shahar ko pur-aman bana. Isi liye farmaya ki Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe budhape mein Ismail-o-Ishaq jaise bachche ata farmai. Hazrat Ismail ko doodh peeta us ki walda ke sath lekar yahan aaye thay tab bhi Aap ne is shahar ke ba-aman hone ki dua ki thi lekin us waqt ke alfaz yeh thay Ayat (Rabbi-j'al haza-l-balada amina-w-wajnubni wa baniyya an na'buda-l-asnam) (Ibrahim: 35). 

Pas is dua mein balad par lam nahi hai, is liye ki yeh dua shahar ki abadi se pehle ki hai aur ab chunke shahar bas chuka tha. Balad ko ma'ruf bi-lam laaye. Surah Baqarah mein hum un cheezon ko wazahat-o-tafsil ke sath zikr kar aaye hain. Phir dusri dua mein apni aulad ko bhi shareek kiya. Insan ko lazim hai ki apni duaaon mein apne ma-baap ko aur aulad ko bhi shamil rakhe. Phir Aap ne buton ki gumraahi unka fitna aksar logon ka behka jana bayan farma kar un se apni bezari ka izhar kiya aur unhen Allah ke hawale kiya ki woh chahe bakhsh_he, chahe saza de. 

Jaise Ruhullah (Alaihis Salam) baroz-e-qayamat kahenge kya agar tu inhein azab kar to yeh tere bande hain aur agar bakhsh de to tu Aziz-o-Hakeem hai. Yeh yaad rahe ki is mein sirf Allah ki mashiyat aur us ke irade ki taraf lotna hai na ki us ke waqie hone ko jaiz samajhna hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Khalilullah ka yeh qaul aur Hazrat Ruhullah ka qaul Ayat (In tu'azzibhum fainnahum 'ibaduka wa in taghfir lahum fainnaka anta-l-'Azizu-l-Hakeem) (Al-Ma'idah: 118), tilawat kar ke ro ro kar apni ummat ko yaad kiya to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ko hukum farmaya ki ja kar daryaft karo ki kyun ro rahe ho?

Ibn Jarir Rahimahullah farmate hain yeh mutalliq hai lafz al-Haram ke sath ya'ani ise ba-hurmat is liye banaya hai ki yahan wale ba-itminan yahan namazein ada kar sakein. Yeh nukta bhi yaad rakhne ke qabil hai ki Aap ne farmaya kuch logon ke dil in ki taraf jhuka de, agar sab logon ke dilon ko in ki taraf jhukane ki dua hoti to Faris-o-Rum, Yahud-o-Nasara, gharz tamam duniya ke log yahan ulat padte. Aap ne sirf musalmanon ke liye yeh dua ki. Aur dua karte hain ki unhein phal bhi inayat farma. Yeh zamin zirat ke qabil bhi nahi aur dua ho rahi hai phalon ki rozi ki. Allah Ta'ala ne yeh dua bhi qubool farmayi jaise irshad hai ayat: (Awa lam numakkina lahum haraman aminan yujbata ilaihi thamaratu kulli shai'in rizqan min ladunna wa lakinna aksarahum la ya'lamun) (Al-Qasas: 57) Ya'ani kya hum ne unhein hurmat aur amni wali aisi jagah inayat nahi farmayi? Jahan har cheez ke phal un ki taraf khinche chale aate hain jo khas hamare paas ki rozi hai. Pas yeh bhi Allah ka khas lutf-o-karam inayat-o-rahm hai ki shahar ki paidawar kuch bhi nahi aur phal har qism ke wahan maujud, charon taraf se wahan chale aayein. Yeh hai Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilur Rahman salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihi ki dua ki qubuliyat.

Munajat-e-Khalilur Rahman (Alaihis Salam / ﷺ) apni munajat mein farmate hain ke aye Allah tu mere irade aur mere maqsud ko mujh se zyada jaanta hai, meri chahat hai ke yahan ke rehne wale teri raza ke talib aur faqat teri taraf raghib rahein. Zahir o batin tujh par roshan hai, zameen o asman ki har cheez ka hal tujh par khula hai. Tera ehsaan hai ke is poore budhape mein tu ne mere haan aulad ata farmai aur ek par ek bacha diya. Ismail bhi, Ishaq bhi. Tu duaoon ka sunne wala aur qubool karne wala hai, main ne manga tu ne diya pas tera shukr hai. Aye Allah mujhe namazon ka paband bana aur meri aulad mein bhi yeh silsila qaim rakh. Meri tamam duaen qubool farma.

Jab yeh zahir ho gaya to aap apne walid se bezar ho gaye. Anbiya ki madad Allah Ta'ala apne waade ko mukarrar aur muakkad kar raha hai ke duniya aakhirat mein jo us ne apne rasoolon ki madad ka waada kiya hai woh kabhi iske khilaaf karne wala nahi. Is par koi aur ghalib nahi woh sab par ghalib hai iske irade se muraad juda nahi iska chaha ho kar rehta hai. Woh kafiron se unke kufr ka badla zaroor lega qayamat ke din un par hasrat o mayusi taari hogi. Us din zameen hogi lekin iske siwa aur hogi isi tarah aasman bhi badal diye jayenge. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain aisi safed saaf zameen par hashar kiye jayenge jaise maiday ki safed tikiya ho jis par koi nishan aur oonch na hogi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain sabse pehle maine hi is aayat ke baare mein Rasool Allah ﷺ se sawal kiya tha ke us waqt log kahan honge? Aap ne farmaya pul sirat par. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke tum ne woh baat poochhi ke meri ummat mein se kisi aur ne yeh baat mujhse nahi poochhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yahi sawal Maai Sahiba R.A ka aayat (Wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi wal arzu jamee'an qabzatuhu yaumal qiyamati was samawatu matwiyyatun bi yaminih, subhanahu wa ta'ala 'amma yushrikun) 39. Az-Zumar: 67 ke mutalliq tha aur aap ne yahi jawab diya tha. Hazrat Soban R.A kehte hain main Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas tha ek yahudi aalim aaya aur us ne aap ka naam le kar salam alaik kaha maine use aise zor se dhakka diya ke qareeb tha ke gir pade us ne mujh se kaha tune mujhe dhakka diya? Maine kaha be-adab ya Rasool Allah nahi kehta? Aur aap ka naam leta hai us ne kaha hum to jo naam in ka unke gharane ke logon ne rakha hai usi naam se pukarenge aap ne فرمایا mere khandan ne mera naam Muhammad hi rakha hai. Yahudi ne kaha suniye main aap se ek baat daryaft karne aaya hoon aap ne farmaya phir mera jawab tujhe koi nafa bhi dega? Us ne kaha sun to loonga aapke haath mein jo tinka tha use aap ne zameen par phiratay hue farmaya ke achha daryaft kar lo us ne kaha sabse pehle pul sirat se paar kaun log honge? Farmaya Muhajireen Fuqara. Us ne poochha unhe sabse pehle tohfa kya milega? Aap ne farmaya machhli ki kaleji ki ziyadi. Us ne poochha iske baad unhe kya ghiza milegi? Farmaya Jannati bail zabah kiya jayega jo jannat ke atraaf mein charta chugta raha tha. Us ne poochha phir peene ko kya milega? Aap ne farmaya Jannati nehar Salsabeel ka pani. Yahudi ne kaha aap ke sab jawab bar-haq hain. Achha ab main ek baat aur poochhta hoon jise ya to nabi jaanta hai ya duniya ke aur do ek aadmi aap ne farmaya kya mera jawab tujhe kuch faida dega? Us ne kaha sun to loonga. Bachhe ke baare mein aap kya farmate hain aap ne farmaya mard ka khaas pani safed rang ka hota hai aur jab aurat ka khaas pani zard rang ka.

Jab yeh dono jama hote hain toh agar mard ka pani ghalib aajaye toh bi-hukm-e-Ilahi larka hota hai aur agar aurat ka pani mard ke pani par ghalib aajaye toh Allah ke hukm se larki hoti hai. Yahudi ne kaha beshak aap sach hain aur yaqinan aap Allah ke paighambar hain. Phir woh wapas chala gaya. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe jawab sikha diya. (Musnad Ahmad) Ibn Jarir Tabri mein hai ke yahudi alim ke pehle sawal ke jawab mein aap ne farmaya us waqt makhlooq Allah ki mehmaani mein hogi pas us ke paas ki cheez un se aajiz na hogi. Amr bin Maimun ؒ kehte hain yeh zameen badal di jayegi aur zameen safed maiday ki tikiya jaisi hogi jis mein na koi khoon baha hoga jis par na koi khata hui hogi aankhein tez hongi dai ki aawaz kaano mein hogi sab nange paon nange badan khare hue honge yahan tak ke pasina misl lagaam ke ho jayega Hazrat Ibn Masood ؓ se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Ek marfoo riwayat mein hai ke safed rang ki woh zameen hogi jis par na khoon ka qatra gira hoga na us par kisi gunah ka amal hua hoga. Isay marfoo karne wala ek hi rawi hai yani Jarir bin Ayyub aur woh qawi nahi. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas apna aadmi bheja phir Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmain se pucha jaante ho main ne aadmi kyun bheja hai? Unhone kaha Allah hi ko ilm hai aur us ke Rasul ko. Aap ne farmaya aayat (Yau-ma tubaddalu-l-ardu ghaira-l-ardi was-samawatu wa barazu lillahi-l-wahidi-l-qahhar) (Surah (Ibrahim: 48) ke bare mein yaad rakho woh us din chandi ki tarah safed hogi. Jab woh log aaye aap ne un se pucha unhone kaha ke safed hogi jaise maida. Aur bhi salaf se marwi hai ke chandi ki zameen hogi. Hazrat Ali ؓ farmate hain ke asman sone ka hoga. Ubay farmate hain woh baaghat bana hua hoga. Muhammad bin Qais kehte hain zameen roti ban jayegi ke momin apne qadmon tale se hi kha lein. Saeed bin Jubair ؓ bhi yehi farmate hain ke zameen badal kar roti ban jayegi. Abdullah bin Masood ؓ farmate hain qayamat ke din saari zameen aag ban jayegi us ke peeche jannat hogi jis ki naimatein baahar se hi nazar aa rahi hongi log apne pasino mein doobe hue honge abhi hisab kitab shuru na hua hoga. Insaan ka pasina pehle qadmon mein hi hoga phir barh kar naak tak pahunch jayega wajah us sakhti aur ghabrahat aur khaufnak manzar ki jo us ki nigaahon ke saamne hai. Ka'ab ؒ kehte hain asman baaghat ban jayenge samundar aag ho jayenge zameen badal di jayegi. Abu Dawood ki hadith mein hai samundar ka safar sirf ghazi ya haaji ya umrah karne wale hi karein. Kyunke samundar ke neeche aag hai ya aag ke neeche samundar hai.

Soor ki mashhoor hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala zameen ko basit kar ke Ukazi chamre ki tarah khinchega is mein koi oonch neech nazar na aayegi phir ek hi aawaz ke sath tamam makhlooq is nayi zameen par phail jayegi phir irshad hai ke tamam makhlooq apni qabron se nikal kar Allah Ta'ala Wahid-o-Qahhar ke samne ro-ba-roo ho jayegi woh Allah jo akela hai aur jo har cheez par ghalib hai sab ki gardanein us ke samne kham hain aur sab us ke tabe-e-farman hain.)

Anbiya ki madad Allah Ta'ala apne waade ko mukarrar aur muakkad kar raha hai ke duniya aakhirat mein jo us ne apne rasoolon ki madad ka waada kiya hai woh kabhi iske khilaaf karne wala nahi. Is par koi aur ghalib nahi woh sab par ghalib hai iske irade se muraad juda nahi iska chaha ho kar rehta hai. Woh kafiron se unke kufr ka badla zaroor lega qayamat ke din un par hasrat o mayusi taari hogi. Us din zameen hogi lekin iske siwa aur hogi isi tarah aasman bhi badal diye jayenge. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain aisi safed saaf zameen par hashar kiye jayenge jaise maiday ki safed tikiya ho jis par koi nishan aur oonch na hogi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain sabse pehle maine hi is aayat ke baare mein Rasool Allah ﷺ se sawal kiya tha ke us waqt log kahan honge? Aap ne farmaya pul sirat par. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke tum ne woh baat poochhi ke meri ummat mein se kisi aur ne yeh baat mujhse nahi poochhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yahi sawal Maai Sahiba R.A ka aayat (Wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi wal arzu jamee'an qabzatuhu yaumal qiyamati was samawatu matwiyyatun bi yaminih, subhanahu wa ta'ala 'amma yushrikun) 39. Az-Zumar: 67 ke mutalliq tha aur aap ne yahi jawab diya tha. Hazrat Soban R.A kehte hain main Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas tha ek yahudi aalim aaya aur us ne aap ka naam le kar salam alaik kaha maine use aise zor se dhakka diya ke qareeb tha ke gir pade us ne mujh se kaha tune mujhe dhakka diya? Maine kaha be-adab ya Rasool Allah nahi kehta? Aur aap ka naam leta hai us ne kaha hum to jo naam in ka unke gharane ke logon ne rakha hai usi naam se pukarenge aap ne فرمایا mere khandan ne mera naam Muhammad hi rakha hai. Yahudi ne kaha suniye main aap se ek baat daryaft karne aaya hoon aap ne farmaya phir mera jawab tujhe koi nafa bhi dega? Us ne kaha sun to loonga aapke haath mein jo tinka tha use aap ne zameen par phiratay hue farmaya ke achha daryaft kar lo us ne kaha sabse pehle pul sirat se paar kaun log honge? Farmaya Muhajireen Fuqara. Us ne poochha unhe sabse pehle tohfa kya milega? Aap ne farmaya machhli ki kaleji ki ziyadi. Us ne poochha iske baad unhe kya ghiza milegi? Farmaya Jannati bail zabah kiya jayega jo jannat ke atraaf mein charta chugta raha tha. Us ne poochha phir peene ko kya milega? Aap ne farmaya Jannati nehar Salsabeel ka pani. Yahudi ne kaha aap ke sab jawab bar-haq hain. Achha ab main ek baat aur poochhta hoon jise ya to nabi jaanta hai ya duniya ke aur do ek aadmi aap ne farmaya kya mera jawab tujhe kuch faida dega? Us ne kaha sun to loonga. Bachhe ke baare mein aap kya farmate hain aap ne farmaya mard ka khaas pani safed rang ka hota hai aur jab aurat ka khaas pani zard rang ka.

Jab yeh dono jama hote hain toh agar mard ka pani ghalib aajaye toh bi-hukm-e-Ilahi larka hota hai aur agar aurat ka pani mard ke pani par ghalib aajaye toh Allah ke hukm se larki hoti hai. Yahudi ne kaha beshak aap sach hain aur yaqinan aap Allah ke paighambar hain. Phir woh wapas chala gaya. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe jawab sikha diya. (Musnad Ahmad) Ibn Jarir Tabri mein hai ke yahudi alim ke pehle sawal ke jawab mein aap ne farmaya us waqt makhlooq Allah ki mehmaani mein hogi pas us ke paas ki cheez un se aajiz na hogi. Amr bin Maimun ؒ kehte hain yeh zameen badal di jayegi aur zameen safed maiday ki tikiya jaisi hogi jis mein na koi khoon baha hoga jis par na koi khata hui hogi aankhein tez hongi dai ki aawaz kaano mein hogi sab nange paon nange badan khare hue honge yahan tak ke pasina misl lagaam ke ho jayega Hazrat Ibn Masood ؓ se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Ek marfoo riwayat mein hai ke safed rang ki woh zameen hogi jis par na khoon ka qatra gira hoga na us par kisi gunah ka amal hua hoga. Isay marfoo karne wala ek hi rawi hai yani Jarir bin Ayyub aur woh qawi nahi. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas apna aadmi bheja phir Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmain se pucha jaante ho main ne aadmi kyun bheja hai? Unhone kaha Allah hi ko ilm hai aur us ke Rasul ko. Aap ne farmaya aayat (Yau-ma tubaddalu-l-ardu ghaira-l-ardi was-samawatu wa barazu lillahi-l-wahidi-l-qahhar) (Surah (Ibrahim: 48) ke bare mein yaad rakho woh us din chandi ki tarah safed hogi. Jakre hue mufsid insan zamin-o-asman badle hue hain. Makhlooq Allah ke samne khadi hai, us din Aye Nabi ﷺ tum dekhoge ke kufr-o-fasad karne wale gunehgar aapas mein jakre bandhe hue honge, har har qism ke gunehgar dusron se mile jule hue honge jaise farman hai ayat: (Uhshurullazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun - 37. (As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ki jor ke logon ko ikathha karo, aur ayat mein hai ayat: (Wa izannufusu zuwwijat - 81. (At-Takwir: 7) jab ke nafs ke jore mila diye jayenge. Aur jagah irshad hai ayat: (Wa iza ulqu minha makanan dayyiqam muqarranina da'aw hunalika thubura - 25. (Al-Furqan: 13) yani jab ke Jahannam ke tang makan mein woh mile jule dale jayenge to wahan woh maut maut pukarenge. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke jinno ki babat bhi ayat: (Wa akharina muqarranina fil asfad - 38. (Sad: 38) ka lafz hai. Asfad kehte hain qaid ki zanjeeron ko, Amr bin Kulsum ke sher mein musafad zanjeeron mein jakre hue qaidi ke mani mein aaya hai. Jo kapre unhe pehnaye jayenge woh gandhak ke honge jo unton ko lagaya jata hai, isse aag tezi aur surat se pakarti hai, yeh lafz qatran bhi hai, qatran bhi hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain: Pighle hue tanbe ko qatran kehte hain, is sakht garam aag jaise tanbe ke in dozakhiyon ke libas honge. Inke munh bhi aapas mein dhake hue honge, chehron tak aag charhi hui hogi, sar se shole buland ho rahe honge, munh bigad gaye honge. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Meri ummat mein char kaam jahiliyat ke hain jo unse na chhotenge: Hasb par fakhr, nasb mein tana zani, sitaron se barish ki talbi, mayyat par nauha karne wali ne agar apni maut se pehle tauba na kar li toh use qayamat ke din gandhak ka kurta aur khujli ka dupatta pehnaya jayega. Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke woh Jannat Dozakh ke darmiyan khari ki jayegi, gandhak ka kurta hoga aur munh par aag khel rahi hogi. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har ek ko uske kamon ka badla dega. Buron ki buraiyan samne aa jayengi. Allah Ta'ala bahut hi jald sari makhlooq ke hisab se farig ho jayega. Mumkin hai yeh ayat bhi misl ayat: (Iqtaraba lin nasi hisabuhum wa hum fi ghaflatin mu'ridun - 21. (Al-Anbiya: 1) ke ho, yani logon ke hisab ka waqt qareeb aa gaya lekin phir bhi woh ghaflat ke sath munh phere hue hi hain. Aur mumkin hai ke bande ke hisab ke waqt ka bayan ho, yani bahut jald hisab se farig ho jayega kyunke woh tamam baton ka janne wala hai, us par ek baat bhi poshida nahi, jaise ek waise hi sari makhlooq. Jaise farman hai: (Ma khalqukum wa la ba'thukum illa ka-nafsin wahidah, innallaha sami'um basir - 31. (Luqman: 28) tum sab ki paidaish aur marne ke baad ka zinda kar dena mujh par aisa hi hai jaise ek ko marna aur jalana.

Yahi ma'ani Mujahid (R.H) ke qaul ke hain ki hisab ke ahate mein Allah Ta'ala bahut jaldi karne wala hai. Haan yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki dono ma'ani murad hon ya'ni waqt-e-hisab bhi qareeb aur Allah ko hisab mein der bhi nahi. Idhar shuru hua idhar khatam hua, Wallahu A'lam.))))))

Tamam insan aur jinn paband-e-it'aat hain, irshad hai ke yeh Quran duniya ki taraf Allah ka khula paigham hai jise aur ayat mein Nabi ﷺ ki zubani kahlwaya gaya hai ke: La undirukum bihi wa man balagha ya'ni taaki main is Quran se tumhein bhi hoshyar kar dun aur jise jise yeh pahuche ya'ni kul insan aur tamam jinat, jaise is surat ke shuru mein farmaya ke is kitab ko hum ne hi teri taraf nazil farmaya hai ke tu logon ko andheron se nikal kar nur ki taraf laye al-akh. Is Quran-e-Karim ki gharz yeh hai ke log hoshyar kar diye jayen, dara diye jayen. Aur is ki dalelein, hujjatein dekh sun kar, parh parh kar tehqeeq se maloom kar lein ke Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai, is ka koi sharik nahi aur aqlmand log naseeyat-o-ibrat, wa'z-o-pand hasil kar lein.
